races.race_name: Tony Linnett Memorial Handicap

runners.name: Nogo's Dream
runners.spotlight: Unplaced on last two starts but hasn't run badly and he's 4lb lower than when runner-up over C&D (good) in June; capable of having a big say.
runners.comment: Runner-up off 4lb higher over C&D in June and hasn't run badly on his two starts since

runners.name: Correspondence
runners.spotlight: Won in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Windsor (5f, good to firm) in May and second at Bath (5f, firm) next time; the track may not have suited at Brighton last time and he could bounce back with a big run.
runners.comment: In top form in these cheekpieces in May and Brighton track may not have suited last time

runners.name: Arry Up
runners.spotlight: 3yo who won his first three handicaps (6f, turf/AW) and bounced back from heavy Ascot defeat (6f, good) with respectable fourth at Kempton (6f, AW) latest; he has plenty of speed and this first crack at 5f is well worth a go.
runners.comment: 3yo who was a respectable fourth last time and this first crack at 5f is well worth a go

runners.name: Neptune Legend
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer who won two in a row in May (5.7f/6f, good to firm) before keeping on for fifth of 13 at Windsor (5f, good to firm), and he was back on the scoresheet at Bath (5.7f, firm) three weeks ago; the return to a bare 5f may not be ideal but the stiff track compensates; respected.
runners.comment: He's won three of his last four; bare 5f may not be ideal but the stiff track compensates

runners.name: Havana Smile
runners.spotlight: Merely sixth of eight at Goodwood last month but his two best performances have coincided with his two visits to Sandown, including a C&D win (good) in May; this lightly raced 3yo is firmly in calculations back here.
runners.comment: Merely sixth at Goodwood last time but he likes this C&D and is firmly in calculations

runners.name: Smart Vision
runners.spotlight: He won three times over 5f last August-October and is 8lb below his last winning mark; drops back in trip today but he's finished down the field on all five starts this season and has plenty to prove.
runners.comment: He's tumbled down the weights but has finished down the field on all five starts this term

runners.name: Brave Nation
runners.spotlight: 6yo who is well handicapped on last season's best efforts for Michael Bell; however, it was a winless campaign and he failed to threaten at Yarmouth in April on his sole run this year; changed hands for 18,500gns last month and he needs to get back on track on this stable debut.
runners.comment: On a reduced mark but needs to get back on track on this stable debut

races.race_name: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Thunder Home
runners.spotlight: Has shown some ability on both starts, when seventh of ten at Ascot (6f, good) then fifth of nine at Lingfield (7f, AW; 16-1 each time); however, takes on some interesting newcomers and could again prove vulnerable.
runners.comment: Unplaced both starts; takes on some interesting newcomers and could again prove vulnerable

runners.name: On Target
runners.spotlight: 160,000euros yearling; first foal; dam made the frame over 6.5f-1m3f in France, half-sister to French winners Muette (1m4f Listed) and Sans Voix (1m 2yo Listed); trainer is enjoying an excellent season with his 2yos and this Sea The Stars newcomer could have a big say.
runners.comment: Newcomer; 160,000euros yearling; trainer is enjoying an excellent season with his 2yos

runners.name: Somerton
runners.spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; third foal; dam German 1m3f and 2m4f (Listed) winner (RPR 93), half-sister to French 1m4f Group 2 winner Now We Can, out of German 1m3f/1m4f winner; a market check is advised but this Ghaiyyath newcomer may come into his own over quite a bit further.
runners.comment: Debut; dam German 2m4f Listed winner; may come into his own over quite a bit further

runners.name: Jinman
runners.spotlight: 80,000euros foal, 170,000gns yearling; seventh foal; Palace Pier half-brother to winners Treizieme (French 1m/8.5f including 2yo), Tik Tok Famous (US 7.5f/1m turf) and Goldis (Slovakian 1m2f); dam placed 1m1f in France, half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Elusive Kate; respected trainer yet to get going with his 2yos this season, but it will be no surprise to see a big run on debut.
runners.comment: 170,000gns yearling; with a respected trainer and no surprise to see a big run on debut
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late John Connolly

runners.name: United Authority
runners.spotlight: 700,000gns yearling; third foal; dam Listed-placed 10.5f/1m4f winner, sister to 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Kingsbarns; it's likely his future lies over further but this Dubawi newcomer is nevertheless high on the list.
runners.comment: 700,000gns yearling; this Dubawi newcomer is high on the list

runners.name: Zero Error
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Mehmas half-brother to 1m4f AW winner Rogue Impact (RPR 94); dam once-raced half-sister to winners Mukhadram (1m2f Group 1) and Woodland Aria (useful 7f/9.4f); with a leading stable; one to consider on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 1m4f AW winner Rogue Impact (RPR 94); with leading yard; one to consider

runners.name: New Oxford
runners.spotlight: 160,000euros yearling; sixth foal; New Bay half-brother to winners Galiac (7f including 2yo; RPR 96), Gallic (1m 2yo/1m2f AW; 92), Galsworthy (1m4f AW; 82) and Galel (7f AW; 65); dam 1m3f/1m4f winner (including Listed; 106), out of 1m Group 1 winner Spinning Queen; may need this debut outing but is bred to be talented and is not ruled out.
runners.comment: 160,000euros yearling; may need this debut run but bred to be talented and not ruled out

runners.name: Harbour Prince
runners.spotlight: £70,000 half-brother to four winners who is open to improvement on this second start; however, he was a well-beaten seventh of ten at 20-1 at Lingfield (7f, AW) this month and a sizeable step forward is needed.
runners.comment: Half-brother to four winners but well-beaten seventh at 20-1 on debut this month

runners.name: Desert Symphony
runners.spotlight: 72,000euros yearling; tenth foal; closely related to 6f 2yo winner Bay Of Plenty (RPR 97), half-sister to five winners including Glesga Gal (7f AW; 100) and Vivianite (1m; 99); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner; potential in pedigree and still early days but has to leave debut run miles behind.
runners.comment: Potential in pedigree and still early days but has to leave debut run miles behind

races.race_name: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)

runners.name: Aperoll
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) last month then finished a close third of 14 against males in the Listed Chesham Stakes at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm; led); leading claims back against fellow fillies.
runners.comment: Close third of 14 against males in the Chesham at Royal Ascot and she has leading claims

runners.name: Bayside View
runners.spotlight: Went very close on debut at Doncaster (6.5f, good to firm) last month before easily making all at 4-9 at Newbury (7f, good to firm); this is a tougher test of her credentials but she could be up to the task.
runners.comment: Easily won at Newbury on second start; tougher test of credentials but could be up to it

runners.name: Tall Trees
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye when fifth to Aperoll on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) in June before keeping on for respectable eighth in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); runner-up in hot maiden at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last time and she might not be far away.
runners.comment: Yet to win but promise on all three starts and she might not be far away

runners.name: Celestia
runners.spotlight: Improved upon her debut run to win at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) recently; had just a short head to spare and her best days are likely to be over further, but she's the type to keep on progressing and is not ruled out.
runners.comment: Narrow maiden win at Carlisle on second start; further is likely to suit but not ruled out

runners.name: Grey Tamam
runners.spotlight: 11-2 when promising third of six on debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; up in grade today but the Nottingham form has received a firm boost from the runner-up and this 140,000euros breeze-up buy is open to considerable improvement; one to watch in the betting.
runners.comment: Promising third on debut at Nottingham and that form has been boosted by the runner-up

runners.name: Lady Caroline Lamb
runners.spotlight: Built upon the promise of her debut third at Kempton (7f, AW) to win at Beverley (7.4f, good) last month; it was a small field last time and the return to a bare 7f isn't an obvious positive, but she's a likeable prospect for the stable that won this in 2019 and 2022.
runners.comment: Won small-field novice at Beverley on second start; stable won this in 2019 and 2022

runners.name: War Banner
runners.spotlight: 2-1, rallied to make winning debut in three-runner novice at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago and the third has won since; this 230,000gns yearling is in top hands and could have lots more to offer, especially now upped to 7f; possible player.
runners.comment: Rallied to make winning debut over 6f at Newmarket and could have lots more to offer

runners.name: Guadalevin
runners.spotlight: She's shown ability in defeat across her three starts (7f, AW/good to firm) but not enough to suggest she'll be making an impact this afternoon.
runners.comment: Has shown ability but not enough to suggest she'll be making an impact this afternoon

races.race_name: Sompo Insurance Handicap

runners.name: Kamaway
runners.spotlight: Won on turf debut at Yarmouth (1m, good) in May before good second there (1m, good) seven days later, and she got up in the final strides at Salisbury (1m, good) last month; the step up in trip could be a positive for this lightly raced 4yo and there's lots to like.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who has won two of her last three and could be suited by this new trip

runners.name: Assail
runners.spotlight: Returned from a break with good third at Kempton (1m3f, AW) last month; his peak efforts have come on AW but he's lightly raced on turf, on which he's shown promise, and he could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Returned from break with good third at Kempton last month and could have part to play

runners.name: Tawajjah
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and well-bred 5yo by Frankel; won a novice at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in November 2024 for Roger Varian and then absent until Newmarket (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago, when runner-up on his handicap and stable debut; could have a big say up in trip if avoiding the dreaded bounce.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Newmarket a fortnight ago following a long absence and could have a big say

runners.name: Londoner
runners.spotlight: Won at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in April and he produced one of his better turf runs when close fifth of eight at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last time; however, a record of 0-22 on grass doesn't inspire confidence.
runners.comment: Produced one of his better turf runs when close fifth at Windsor but he's 0-22 on grass

runners.name: Morcar
runners.spotlight: Returned to form to win at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) this month and he's since been second at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm), albeit no match for the progressive winner; there's every chance he'll be in the mix.
runners.comment: Won at Newbury this month then runner-up at Windsor; every chance he'll be in the mix

runners.name: Percival
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has failed to kick on since 2yo win for Andre Fabre in November 2024; well beaten at Yarmouth on last month's stable debut; others arrive with a lot less to prove.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who has failed to kick on since 2yo win for Andre Fabre in November 2024

races.race_name: George Lindon-Travers Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Alma Latina
runners.spotlight: All four races on good ground; two places before she got off the mark in a four-runner maiden at Pontefract (1m2f) in June; favourite when upped to 1m4f for handicap debut at Epsom four weeks later, coming from off the pace for a creditable third of ten off this mark despite persistently hanging left; 1m6f is plausible on that display and she may still have more to give.
runners.comment: Creditable 3rd of ten on handicap debut at Epsom (1m4f) despite persistently hanging left

runners.name: My Ballyquinn
runners.spotlight: Won two of his three handicaps (on good) and beaten a head in the other (good to firm); collared the odds-on front-runner close home when upped to 1m6f in eight-runner race at York last time; raised another 5lb but progressive and still promising.
runners.comment: Got up close home when upped to 1m6f at York last time; raised 5lb but still promising

runners.name: Probation
runners.spotlight: Improved when upped in trip for handicap debut at Lingfield (11.6f, good to firm) eight days ago, coming from last of three to lead 2f out and win by 12l under Alexandra Egan; has 6lb penalty (due to go up another 1lb) but did it easily that day and has clear potential for this sort of trip.
runners.comment: Now has a 6lb penalty but won easily when upped to 11.6f for handicap debut eight days ago

races.race_name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Talitha Rouge
runners.spotlight: Close third of six at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) on debut in May, which she's not lived up to in her two starts since but these are early days and this is her handicap debut; needs a second look.
runners.comment: Best form on debut; early days and this is her handicap debut; needs a second look

runners.name: Aravalli
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; tailed off on her stable/handicap debut (1m4f, good to soft) early last month, but 33-1 winner at Chepstow (1m4f) next time and she followed up in four-runner race at same track (1m2f, again good to firm) eight days later; penalty makes her only another 2lb higher today and she's on a roll.
runners.comment: On a roll with 1m4f/1m2f wins at Chepstow; penalty makes her 2lb higher than last time

runners.name: Albertini Star
runners.spotlight: Off 218 days when making her handicap debut in a first-time hood at Nottingham (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, coming from towards rear to emerge in second of eight to an impressive winner; has the same mark today, could have come on for the run and gave hope for 1m2f.
runners.comment: Off 218 days when 2nd of 8 on handicap debut at Nottingham (1m), coming from towards rear

runners.name: Pershalla
runners.spotlight: Sole win (ten races) was over 1m4f on the Kempton AW in April in first-time hood, which has been kept since; same mark today, having been out of form on last three outings (back to 1m2f for latest); others preferred.
runners.comment: Won off this mark in April; out of form on last three outings, back to 1m2f for latest

runners.name: We Ride At Dawn
runners.spotlight: Improved when second of ten in a handicap at Windsor (upped to 1m2f, good to firm) early last month; fair fourth of seven at Bath one month later over 11.6f which might have stretched her (made most); may have more to offer back at this trip but it is needed.
runners.comment: 11.6f might have stretched her; may have more to offer back at this trip but it is needed

runners.name: Shirakawa
runners.spotlight: Sent handicapping for last three starts, comfortably on top at Bath (1m2f, good) on second occasion and making all in five-runner race at Salisbury (1m2f, good to firm) 12 days ago; hung on by a head last time and raised another 4lb today, which demands better but she has been on the upgrade.
runners.comment: 1m2f wins at Bath and Salisbury (made all; hung on by a head) on last two outings

runners.name: Huggable
runners.spotlight: Won off 4lb lower at Epsom (1m2f, good) last August in her second handicap; runner-up on next two starts but much less impact since (despite being prominent in the betting on last two outings) and needs to turn things around with the first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Much less impact on last four starts; needs to turn things around in first-time tongue-tie

races.race_name: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap

runners.name: Sail On Sailor
runners.spotlight: Won at Bath (1m, good) in May on third start for new yard and completed the hat-trick at Epsom (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; had just a neck to spare last time but he's just 3lb higher today and there can be optimism that this smooth-travelling 3yo still has more left in the tank.
runners.comment: 3yo who has won his last three and could still have more left in the tank

runners.name: Gone Rogue
runners.spotlight: Went close at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance and returned to form to win at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) recently; he likes that seaside venue and drops back in trip today, but he is capable of running well away from Brighton and at 1m, so he could be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: 1m2f win at Brighton recently; could be in the shake-up despite the drop back in trip

runners.name: Lodge
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who hasn't progressed since making a promising start to her career last year; however, there have been hints that this first crack at 1m will suit, when keeping on for fifth at both Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in January and Leicester (6f, good to firm) this month; not discounted.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who hasn't progressed but has hinted this first crack at 1m may suit

runners.name: Strong Voice
runners.spotlight: Promise on both 2yo starts (7f, AW) and, following wind surgery, he kept on for a close second on last month's handicap debut at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) where he had to wait for a clear run; open to further improvement back up to 1m and this 3yo is on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Denied a clear run before keeping on for second on handicap debut; on the shortlist

runners.name: Prodigal Son
runners.spotlight: Won on reappearance at Bath (1m, firm) in April in first-time blinkers (retained); some respectable efforts since but needs something extra if he's to return to winning ways today.
runners.comment: Won on reappearance at Bath; some respectable efforts since but needs something extra here

runners.name: Marsh Benham
runners.spotlight: Patchy campaign last season but he's 2lb lower than when winning at Newbury (1m, good) last May and reappeared with a good second at Brighton (1m, good to firm) last month; in the mix if backing that up.
runners.comment: Patchy campaign last season but reappeared with good second; in the mix if backing it up

runners.name: Billy Mill
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three times in a row on AW this April-June, but below-par sixth at Kempton (1m, AW) three weeks ago and he failed to shine when tackling turf last year; has his first outing on grass of 2026.
runners.comment: In good form on AW prior to lesser run last time; failed to shine on turf last year

runners.name: Dalmally
runners.spotlight: He's dropped down the weights and didn't run badly when third of seven at Brighton (7f, good to firm) recently, but he's 0-12 in handicaps and needs a bigger performance if he's to come out on top today.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly at Brighton recently but 0-12 in handicaps and needs a bigger performance

runners.name: Berning Hot
runners.spotlight: Returned to form when runner-up at Kempton (1m, AW) in May, but down the field at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) since and she's won just one of her 18 starts; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Runner-up on AW in May but down the field since and she has a poor strike-rate

runners.name: Amused
runners.spotlight: Back on song when runner-up at Lingfield (7f, good) last month, but he's struggled on both runs since; very awkward at the start and soon tailed off when 40-1 over C&D (good) three weeks ago; risky.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Lingfield last month but he's struggled on both runs since; risky
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Ararat
runners.spotlight: Having dropped down the weights he returned to form when third at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last month; however, a lesser run followed at Ascot (7f, good to firm) and he's unproven at 1m.
runners.comment: Back to form when third at Newbury but lesser run followed at Ascot; unproven at 1m

runners.name: Double Time
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won at Kempton (1m, AW) last October; however, this 8yo wasn't at the top of his game at Southwell (1m, AW) in January and he may improve for this first outing since.
runners.comment: AW win last October but this 8yo may improve for today's first outing since January

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Night Star
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on his debut and shaped quite well when a closing third in a C&D novice (good to firm) a fortnight ago; looks capable of better again and the clear pick of those with experience.
runners.comment: Promising third over C&D a fortnight ago and the clear pick of those with experience

runners.name: Jassas
runners.spotlight: Dubawi brother to 1m winner Blue Nazare (RPR 93); dam Listed-placed 6f winner (including 2yo; 96); the Charlie Appleby 2yos are in excellent form.
runners.comment: Newcomer who makes obvious appeal with the Charlie Appleby 2yos in excellent form

runners.name: Kaito
runners.spotlight: From a top stable but hasn't achieved near enough in his two starts (well-held fourth latterly) to think he can win a novice.
runners.comment: From a top stable but hasn't achieved enough to think he can win a novice
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Lead The Squad
runners.spotlight: 550,000euros son of Sea The Stars out of a 1m4f AW winner (RPR 94); stable 10-38 with 2yos this season at the time of writing; his pedigree points to longer trips suiting in due course but he'd need considering if the betting signals are strong.
runners.comment: 550,000euros son of Sea The Stars out of a 1m4f AW winner; betting informative

runners.name: Mister Whippy
runners.spotlight: 150,000euros yearling who is the first foal of a winning half-sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Shareta; gelded ahead of debut; the yard is going well in general but its 2yos have yet to really get going.
runners.comment: From a good yard but its 2yos have yet to really get going in 2026

runners.name: Narrjoo
runners.spotlight: This Ten Sovereigns colt cost 200,000gns at the breeze-ups and is a half-brother to winners UAE Prince (1m2f-1m4f; RPR 109) and Any Dream Will Do (1m; 86); in-form stable has a very healthy 2yo strike-rate this year, including a short-priced first-time-out winner in these silks at Nottingham last week; market confidence behind this one would look significant
runners.comment: 200,000gns breeze-up buy; market support significant for in-form stable

runners.name: Peak Tram
runners.spotlight: American-bred colt who was green when quite a well-held fourth of ten on 7f Lingfield (AW) debut 17 days ago; more one for the longer term on that evidence.
runners.comment: Green when well-held fourth on recent AW debut

runners.name: Mino
runners.spotlight: 16-1 when never better than midfield on his 7f Lingfield (AW) debut 17 days ago; needs to have come on a lot.
runners.comment: Didn't show near enough on recent AW debut to make him the likely winner here

runners.name: Hey Dude
runners.spotlight: Always behind on both starts; big outsider.
runners.comment: Always behind on both starts; big outsider

races.race_name: Doncaster Supports Autism In Racing EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Round The Table
runners.spotlight: Promise amidst inexperience in a useful Newbury maiden on debut and looked a useful prospect when easily taking a Ffos Las maiden (1m2f, good) under David Egan last month; surely more to come.
runners.comment: Made debut in a warm race and won easily at Ffos Las since; useful prospect

runners.name: Interstate
runners.spotlight: Two AW starts last autumn, leaving his Kempton debut well behind when going down by only a neck at Southwell (1m); this is a slightly belated return but he should have more to offer for a leading stable going great guns; wears first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Two AW runs at 2, leaving debut behind when second at Kempton; headgear on; more to come

runners.name: Dancingondiamonds
runners.spotlight: Fifth in two Flat maidens in Ireland (1m/1m4f) for Joseph O'Brien, showing fair form on the first occasion; no show in two recent hurdle starts since joining Olly Murphy and comes up against a couple of promising sorts back on the level.
runners.comment: Fifth in two Flat runs in Ireland; no show in a pair of hurdles for Olly Murphy
runners.owner: The Soldiers Of Fortune Iv & Partner

runners.name: Twin And Tonic
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well held both starts.
runners.comment: Big prices and well held both starts

races.race_name: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Ten Clarets
runners.spotlight: Fourth to Inner City Blues (also next-time-out winners in second/third) on 6f York debut and built on that, despite failing to land short odds, when close second over 7f at Ayr 17 days ago (both good ground); cheekpieces are added now making a quick switch to handicaps from a mark which looks workable.
runners.comment: Promise both starts, going down by neck latterly; cheekpieces added; mark looks workable

runners.name: Shadow King
runners.spotlight: Dark Angel colt who stepped up on turf debut when making all at Kempton (6f, AW) in May; freshened up since finishing a well held last of three in conditions race at Goodwood (6f, good to soft) later that month; blinkered first time now handicapping from a mark which isn't obviously generous.
runners.comment: AW winner; off since last of three at Goodwood in May; blinkers are added
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Rhodes Runner
runners.spotlight: Hasn't lived up to market expectations on all three starts but has steadily advanced her RPRs; didn't really sustain her effort when second on 7f Kempton nursery debut three weeks ago so the slight drop back in trip may help.
runners.comment: Has advanced RPR with each start, including second on 7f nursery debut

runners.name: Jumeirah Storm
runners.spotlight: Built on debut fourth when winning a 6f course novice (good to firm) 20 days ago; the form has been franked, including by the fourth making a winning nursery debut at Windsor on Monday; should be more to come.
runners.comment: Won a novice over the bare 6f here 20 days ago and the form has been franked

runners.name: Attack Attack
runners.spotlight: Well held on first two starts but showed a bit more when third of five to a Godolphin odds-on shot over 7f at Yarmouth (good to firm) three weeks ago; the first-time hood worn on that occasion is left off now dropping back a little in distance for her nursery debut.
runners.comment: Best effort when third in 7f Yarmouth novice latest; nursery debut

races.race_name: Summer Saturdays At Doncaster Handicap

runners.name: Alfa Duplicate
runners.spotlight: Three handicap wins this year, the latest at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in May; creditable efforts in defeat in a trio of handicaps over this minimum trip since; just as effective at 6f and enters calculations with the Ivan Furtado stable among the winners.
runners.comment: Three wins this year; creditable effort in defeat of late and her stable is going well

runners.name: Seeing Stars
runners.spotlight: Raced at 7f, winning Kempton maiden (AW) in January on fourth start; has run well to make the frame in her three handicaps since, latterly third of ten to Accademia (won since) here (good to firm) three weeks ago; led until inside the final furlong on that occasion so the drop to 6f is worth exploring.
runners.comment: Led until inside final furlong in 7f course handicap latest so drop to 6f may suit

runners.name: Sargent Dennis
runners.spotlight: All races at 6f, taking a step forward for the switch to turf when well on top from two subsequent winners in 6f Windsor maiden (good to firm) in May; his opening handicap mark looks manageable, particularly as he has the potential for better again.
runners.comment: Ready winner of 6f Windsor maiden in May and taken to follow up on handicap debut

runners.name: Lamlash Bay
runners.spotlight: Struck at the second time of asking in handicaps when making all under Lewis Chalkley at Ripon (6f, good) 17 days ago; his three closest pursuers haven't done much for the form since but he was comfortably on top and his unexposed profile provides the hope for better again.
runners.comment: Made all at Ripon 17 days ago; form has taken a few knocks but he did win comfortably

runners.name: Ay Up Duck
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win at the third attempt in 7f maiden at Southwell in April but has struggled in three handicaps since;
runners.comment: 7f Southwell maiden winner in April but has struggled in handicaps since

runners.name: Bucklow Hill
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a Group 3 winner; justified market support when overcoming inexperience to win a 6f maiden at Lingfield (AW) in January but well below that level in two subsequent turf outings, returning from a gelding operation to finish a remote third of six in Leicester novice (good to firm) in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) 19 days ago; needs to leave that well behind now moving into a handicap.
runners.comment: AW debut winner but below par on turf runs since; makes handicap with something to prove

runners.name: Blue Orbit
runners.spotlight: 5f maiden winner at Goodwood (good to firm) last June; reached the frame for the third time in handicaps this year when fourth of eight at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but he'll need more to get his head back in front.
runners.comment: Some creditable efforts in handicaps this year without suggesting his turn is near

runners.name: Frio
runners.spotlight: Hasn't matched his fairly useful debut RPR for the Quinn yard in two subsequent outings but he did make quite an encouraging return from a year off for his new stable when fourth in C&D novice (good) ten weeks ago; potential improver in handicaps.
runners.comment: Has shown promise, including over C&D for new yard after year off; handicap debut

races.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap

runners.name: Commander Of Life
runners.spotlight: Has run a number of good in defeat races this season, including fourth over C&D last month; went down only to a progressive 3yo at Newbury (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago and the third and fourth have franked that form; bold show likely.
runners.comment: Form of latest Newbury second boosted and looks ready to win again soon

runners.name: Farandaway
runners.spotlight: It took him 17 attempts to put his head in front but has now won two of his last three, finding plenty tackling 7f for the first time when seeing off a couple of strong challengers in handicap at Thirsk (good to firm) 22 days ago; respected up 3lb.
runners.comment: Found plenty to win Thirsk handicap latest, his first attempt at 7f; respected up 3lb

runners.name: Straight A
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice in May (C&D on good to firm first occasion); caught too far back when fourth over 1m here last time; likely still in good form but needs things to drop right the way he's ridden.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D in May but this hold-up performer does need things to fall right

runners.name: Lumenbourg
runners.spotlight: Opened this year's account when making all in amateur riders' race at Carlisle (6f, good to soft) last month; creditable fourth over 6f here next time but below par back at Carlisle 19 days ago; former C&D winner but has yet to defy a mark this high.
runners.comment: Four wins, including C&D, but they all been gained from lower marks than this
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho

runners.name: Al Muqdad
runners.spotlight: Went close over C&D (good to firm) last month and 1m seemed to stretch him back here since (all wins at 7f, including here); his last success came off this mark; likely to be on the premises under Rodriguez.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D in June; stamina seemingly stretched over 1m since (all wins at 7f)

runners.name: Jenni
runners.spotlight: Won at Musselburgh (7f, good) off 10lb higher last year; has largely struggled since but latest Catterick fourth from well off the pace was a step back in the right direction and has obvious handicapping scope if able to build on that.
runners.comment: Largely struggled since 7f win last year but latest Catterick fourth was more encouraging

runners.name: War Howl
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f this time last year for Mick Appleby but has yet to get anywhere near for new yard this year; well handicapped but could only consider if the betting suggests he's likely to leave his recent efforts behind.
runners.comment: Well treated on his two wins last summer but has yet to get anywhere near for new yard
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Mariner
runners.spotlight: Latest Nottingham third in this headgear was a bit better and he'll be a threat to all if recapturing the form he showed when a close second over C&D (good to firm) off 2lb higher in April, particularly with Jack Callan taking an additional 3lb off.
runners.comment: Latest third okay and big player if back to form he showed when second over C&D in April

runners.name: Albeyours
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who has form figures of 12531 since wearing cheekpieces, most recently seeing off nine rivals at Carlisle (7f) in June; has a likeable profile for this grade but the wins have been achieved on good to soft/soft and she needs to prove she's as effective on today's likely much faster ground.
runners.comment: Both wins on softer than good and needs to prove she's as good on a quicker surface

runners.name: Palmarian
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on first run over 1m at Leicester (good to firm) this month, despite not getting the best of runs; backed it up when running on from the rear for neck second over C&D (good to firm) last Saturday; out again before a 2lb rise for that kicks in.
runners.comment: Has 1m Leicester win and close second over C&D to show for two outings this month
runners.owner: MDP Racing And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Theme Park
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but has reduced mark as a result and he was backed into joint favouritism at Pontefract last week only to blow the start; has a first-time tongue-tie added now; it'll be interesting to see whether his supporters are prepared to give him a second chance.
runners.comment: Well treated and attracted support only to blow the start last time; tongue-tie added now

runners.name: We've Got This
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f handicap at Redcar (good to firm) last summer off 2lb lower and bounced back to that sort of form when third of ten to Farandaway (runs in previous race) over 7f at Thirsk (good to firm) three weeks ago; in a lower grade now and should have a big say with Ivan Furtado among the winners.
runners.comment: 7f fast-ground win last summer and latest Thirsk third suggests he may be ready to strike

runners.name: Boubyan
runners.spotlight: Both wins off higher marks; has an inconsistent profile and hasn't built on April's Pontefract second in two subsequent outings but he might have just needed it at Brighton recently after three months off.
runners.comment: Not the most consistent but may have just needed it last time after a break

runners.name: Whiskey Pete
runners.spotlight: Only win in 26 runs was a 1m nursery at York in October 2023 for Ralph Beckett; badly out of form this season and cheekpieces made no difference last time; they are replaced by a first-time tongue-tie now.
runners.comment: Just 1-26 and badly out of sorts this year; new tongue-tie needs to make big difference

runners.name: Chilly Breeze
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced gelding who hasn't progressed from his 5f 2yo success, including in three outings between 7f and 1m for Ian Williams this year; this is a drop in grade but would need to see market support to consider.
runners.comment: Hasn't threatened in three outings for Ian Williams; could only consider if backed

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners.name: Brighlee
runners.spotlight: Struggled on her first two outings this year but back on track stepped up to 1m2f when third in 11-runner handicap at Newbury (good to firm) three weeks ago, staying on having had to switch to get a run; the first two from that race have run well since; considered from an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Back on form when third of 11 at Newbury latest, her first start at 1m2f; considered

runners.name: Saxophonist
runners.spotlight: Has failed to build on his 1m course handicap debut third in the spring in two subsequent outings, including stepped up to 1m2f at Ripon last time.
runners.comment: Hasn't built in 1m course handicap debut third in two subsequent runs, including 1m2f

runners.name: Alterity
runners.spotlight: Front-running filly whose RPRs are moving in the right direction; dominated a small-field maiden at Ripon (1m, good to firm) 17 days ago and her pedigree points to this move up to 1m2f suiting now handicapping.
runners.comment: Progressive RPRs, making all with ease in 1m maiden latest; respected handicap newcomer

runners.name: Shadow Brigade
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who showed his opening mark to be workable when 1l fourth over 1m2f at Windsor (good to firm) ten days ago, albeit it came in a steadily run race; first-time blinkers go on now.
runners.comment: Beaten only 1l when fourth on recent 1m2f handicap; blinkers are added now

runners.name: Zarco
runners.spotlight: Similar form in three qualifying runs over 7f/1m last autumn; gelded ahead of this handicap debut and reappearance over a trip which is bred to suit; would enter calculations if the betting vibes are strong.
runners.comment: Gelded ahead of handicap debut and reappearance over longer trip; one to note in betting

runners.name: Time Twister
runners.spotlight: Failed to better modest form in five outings as a juvenile, including a couple of handicaps; a watching brief is the percentage call after ten months off.
runners.comment: Modest form as a juvenile, including two handicaps; off for ten months

races.race_name: Frank Conroy Irish EBF Maiden

runners.name: Shakespeare
runners.spotlight: Dubawi colt cost 1,300,000gns as a yearling, dam a 7f-1m2f winner (inc AW/Group 1; RPR 120) and half-sister to Speak In Colours (6f Group 2 winner); stable third-choice but plenty of debut promise in Curragh maiden in late June, staying on well after racing keenly early on to finish third behind two stablemates (7f); extra furlong should suit and could prove hard to beat.
runners.comment: Promising Curragh debut third could prove hard to beat now upped in trip

runners.name: Green Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Churchill colt; 40,000euros yearling; half-brother to winners Spirit Of Saxony (7f AW; RPR 89), Coolmeen Vega (Spanish 7.5f-8.5f) and Pure Circle (Italian 6f); dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Jessica's Dream; stable second-choice on debut in Killarney maiden 10 days ago, showing definite promise when beaten just over 3l, tiring late over today's trip; could well improve enough to play a role (holds big-race entries).
runners.comment: Encouraging enough recent Killarney debut effort to warrant consideration here

runners.name: Activity
runners.spotlight: Gleneagles colt cost 120,000euros as a yearling; second foal of a 1m winner (RPR 87), a half-sister to winners Helvezia (7f) and Caballero (7f 2yo); yard has a 16% strike rate with it's 2yos this season.
runners.comment: Gleneagles colt cost 120,000euros; yard has a 16% strike rate with it's 2yos this season

runners.name: Darkness Falls
runners.spotlight: Camelot half-brother to 6f 2yo winner The Flying Seagull (RPR 85); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (97), half-sister to winners Shevchenko (useful 7f/1m) and Tigris River (1m6f Flat and smart 2m-2m4f hurdle), out of an Irish 1,000 Guineas winner.
runners.comment: Camelot half-brother to 6f 2yo winner The Flying Seagull; dam Listed-placed 5f winner
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Highest Order
runners.spotlight: Dark Angel colt; 3rd foal of a 7f winner (RPR 81), a sister to useful 7f-2m winner Duty Of Care, half-sister to Breeders' Cup Mile winner Expert Eye; family of 1,000 Guineas winner Special Duty; yard having a good season with it's 2yos so newcomer of definite interest, especially if strong in the market (although no big-race entries).
runners.comment: Yard having a good season with it's 2yos so newcomer of definite interest

runners.name: The Long Haul
runners.spotlight: Inns Of Court gelding is first foal of a 1m/9.5f winner (inc AW; RPR 61), a half-sister to winners Fearless Angel (Listed-placed 5f 2yo), Go Vince Go (5f/6f) and Dark Oak (1m4f); debutant best watched.
runners.comment: Debutant best watched

races.race_name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Sea Of Rain
runners.spotlight: Naval Crown filly has put together series of good runs in defeat, including nose C&D defeat last month, most recently front-running clear third over C&D a week ago; will again run her race but remains vulnerable to above-average newcomers.
runners.comment: Twice narrowly beaten over C&D; respected but vulnerable to above-average newcomers

runners.name: Violet Be Humble
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam placed 6f 2yo, half-sister to winners Oh Purple Reign (Listed-placed 6f-1m) and Warsaw Road (7f); dam placed 6f 2yo (70); shaped with some promise on Bellewstown debut early this month but this looks a stronger race.
runners.comment: Shaped with some promise on recent Bellewstown debut but this looks a stronger race

runners.name: Miss Twilight
runners.spotlight: Soldier's Call filly; fourth foal; dam poor maiden half-sister to several winners, notably Fanaar (1m UAE Group 3); first 2yo runner of the season for the yard, seems best watched.
runners.comment: First 2yo runner of the season for the yard, seems best watched

runners.name: Lusted
runners.spotlight: Hello Youmzain filly cost 6,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to French 1m4f winner Imperious Man; dam French 8.5f AW winner, half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Sofast; yard had a 2yo winner at Down Royal last week.
runners.comment: Hello Youmzain filly a 6,000euros yearling; yard had 2yo winner at Down Royal last week

runners.name: Sherry Eyed
runners.spotlight: Pinatubo filly is second foal; dam placed 1m/9.4f (RPR 71), half-sister to winners Eternal Silence (Group-placed 1m) and Chiara Luna (useful 6f/8.5f inc 2yo), out of 1m4f Group 2 winning half-sister to 1m6f Group 1 winner Royal Diamond; market well worth a check on debut.
runners.comment: Nicely-bred newcomer has to be worth a market check

runners.name: Armarone's Girl
runners.spotlight: State Of Rest filly cost 34,000euros as a foal; half-sister to winners Loaded Gun (5f-1m2f inc AW/2yo/Qatar; RPR 81) and Another Bertie (5f/6f AW; 54); dam 7f 2yo winner (85), half-sister to 5f 2yo Listed winner Roxan; rare 2yo runner for the yard and likely all the better for the experience.
runners.comment: Rare 2yo runner for the yard and likely all the better for the experience

runners.name: Coastal Wonder
runners.spotlight: Bayside Boy filly cost 80,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Wonderful Times (1m2f inc AW/French Listed; RPR 101), Wondrous Words (1m2f; 89) and Megalithic (Qatari 7f); dam 6f/7f (Group 3) 2yo winner (105), sister to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Gustav Klimt; quite nicely-bred newcomer, worth a market check.
runners.comment: 80,000euros Bayside Boy filly; quite nicely-bred newcomer, worth a market check

runners.name: Churchill Bond
runners.spotlight: Pinatubo filly cost 300,000euros at the Arqana breeze-ups; half-sister to winners Golden Bugle (1m4f/13.5f; RPR 90) and Golden Love (1m; 59); dam 1m winner (inc Listed; 107), half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Footstepsinthesand and 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Pedro The Great; holds Lowther and Moyglare entries; obvious appeal from top yard.
runners.comment: 300,000euros breeze-up buy holds Lowther and Moyglare entries; obvious appeal

runners.name: Villaray
runners.spotlight: Showcasing filly is first foal of a 1m AW winner (RPR 91), who is closely related to Group-placed 1m1f 2yo winner Green Storm; yard have a 20% strike rate with it's 2yos this season.
runners.comment: Showcasing filly; yard have a 20% strike rate with it's 2yos this season

runners.name: Ballymackney
runners.spotlight: Earthlight filly cost 20,000euros; couple of ordinary efforts in 5f maidens, now upped markedly in trip; more likely one for a nursery.
runners.comment: Couple of ordinary efforts in 5f maidens, now upped markedly in trip; one for a nursery

runners.name: Lily Bear
runners.spotlight: Showed up well in a barrier trial but failed to run to market expectations over C&D last month, having reportedly got upset in the stalls; improvement likely.
runners.comment: Upset in the stalls on C&D debut last month when disappointing; improvement likely

runners.name: Citrus Springs
runners.spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 65,000USD as a yearling, 300,000USD at Ocala in March; early speed before fading quite badly on Listowel debut in late May behind a stablemate; much more needed.
runners.comment: Early speed before fading quite badly on Listowel debut in late May; much more needed

races.race_name: Saudi Cup Silver Flash Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)

runners.name: Alpha
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly out of the brilliant Alpha Centauri; debut second over C&D last month to Blonde Over Blue (soft) before bolting up over the same trip on quicker ground in Curragh maiden later in month, making all (second beaten odds-on favourite since, third has won since) to win under hands and heels; high-class filly in the making, major player.
runners.comment: Impressive Curragh maiden winner; high-class filly in the making, major player
runners.owner: Flaxman Stables, Mrs Magnier, M Tabor, D Smith

runners.name: Dancing Destiny
runners.spotlight: Magna Grecia filly won a Roscommon maiden and most recently nicely improved to land Naas Listed over a mile, relishing stamina test; going the right way but this likely a much stiffer task.
runners.comment: Improved to land Naas Listed over a 1m; going the right way but this a much stiffer task

runners.name: Cedrela
runners.spotlight: By Prix de l'Abbaye winner Wooded and cost 41,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to French 6f-7.5f winner Viva La Skids (inc 2yo; RPR 103); dam maiden, is out of half-sister to US 1m2f Grade 1 winner Desert Blanc; has missed two engagements (coughing/off feed); eye-catching jockey booking for belated debut.
runners.comment: Has missed two engagements (coughing/off feed); notable jockey booking for belated debut

runners.name: Tosca No Candis
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly took a step in the right direction in Naas Listed early this month when staying on fifth (beaten 3.5l) behind Dancing Destiny over 1m; lots more required here.
runners.comment: Some improvement behind Dancing Destiny at Naas; lots more required now

runners.name: Blonde Over Blue
runners.spotlight: Lope De Vega filly cost 260,000gns as a foal and 400,000gns as a yearling; first foal; dam 1m1f-1m4f winner (inc AW/Italian Group 3; RPR 105); not especially strong in the market when making winning debut last month in C&D fillies' maiden, handy throughout off steady pace and getting first run on strong-finishing second Alpha; very interesting rematch with that rival who  has won impressively since.
runners.comment: C&D debut win over subsequent winner Alpha last month; interesting rematch here

runners.name: Nevermindtherain
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never half-sister to Group 1 juvenile winner Puerto Rico; steady improvement in three maiden runs, most recently third over C&D a fortnight ago; that form looks a long way off what is likely required here and cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Steadily progressive maiden form but huge improvement needed here
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

races.race_name: Japan Racing Association Tyros Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Florida Bay
runners.spotlight: Finished third over C&D on debut and improved from that to take a Fairyhouse maiden over 7f; seemed to get outstayed over 1m in a Naas listed race last time and coming back to this trip can suit; looks the stable second-string but can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Seemed to get outstayed over 1m last time; stable second-string but can't be ruled out

runners.name: Aix La Chapelle
runners.spotlight: Superbly bred colt was the second-string on debut when winning a Curragh maiden over this trip; his better fancied stablemate, Giant Sequoia, finished third and has since won a Curragh maiden; reared in the stalls and was withdrawn before the start of the Chesham Stakes when 11/4; a big player if there is no repeat of that behaviour; stable first-string.
runners.comment: Beat a stablemate on debut who has won since; more to come and looks a big player

runners.name: Folsom Blues
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise on debut at the Curragh over 6f and was much-improved to run away with a Gowran maiden over 7f since; the form of that race is solid and if this colt is as effective on this sounder surface then he should be a major player; looks the yard first-string.
runners.comment: Easy 7f Gowran maiden winner on soft; major player if as effective on faster ground

runners.name: Nail House
runners.spotlight: An 80,000gns yearling; started 3/1 second fav' for a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and showed a good attitude to score, beating Supreme Lord into third by 1l; the fourth that day won at the Curragh last weekend and this colt should have improved since; seems stable second-string.
runners.comment: Won a 6f Fairyhouse maiden on debut, beating Supreme Lord 1l; seems stable second-string

runners.name: Tio Joao
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to 6f turf/7f AW winner Ze Do Asfalto (RPR 84); dam 7f AW 2yo winner (78), sister to 5f/6f winner Awsaaf, half-sister to prolific 5f/6f winner Street Life; second runner for yard; decent pedigree but will have to be a smart sort to take this on debut.
runners.comment: Decent pedigree but will have to be a smart sort to take this on debut

runners.name: Supreme Lord
runners.spotlight: Cost 400,000gns as a yearling; started 5/2 fav' and ran a solid race on debut at Fairyhouse over 6f, beaten 1l by Nail House; and this colt should have improved since so there shouldn't be much between them today.
runners.comment: Ran a solid race on debut at Fairyhouse over 6f but this is a significant step up in class

races.race_name: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap

runners.name: Dark Viper
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come at this track over 1m in varying ground conditions; cracking effort back here last time over that trip; up 3lb but the extra furlong is a question.
runners.comment: Cracking effort here last time over a mile; up 3lb but the extra furlong is a question

runners.name: Wild Sapphire
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a Killarney maiden over 1m recently; has run well over C&D before so should be fine on that score; the tongue-tie worn last time is retained; a player.
runners.comment: Won a Killarney maiden over 1m recently; has run well over C&D before and is a player

runners.name: Harmani
runners.spotlight: Opened his account when emphatically winning a Down Royal handicap over 1m2.5f in May; got a 15lb hike for that and has found life difficult twice since; down 2lb.
runners.comment: Got a 15lb hike for Down Royal win and has found life difficult twice since; down 2lb

runners.name: Glyndwr
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner for Ger Lyons ran his best race for this yard when fifth over 1m at this track last time; was staying on that day so this extra furlong should be a help; considered.
runners.comment: Staying on over 1m here last time so this extra furlong should be a help; considered

runners.name: Manton Bay
runners.spotlight: Won an AW maiden over this trip last winter; cracking efforts first two starts this term on turf, over 1m at Naas and 1m2f at Navan; not as good at the Curragh last time off this mark.
runners.comment: Two good runs to begin the season but not as good at the Curragh last time off this mark

runners.name: Eastern Peace
runners.spotlight: Won a Dundalk maiden over 1m2.5f last November; best run since was when third in a 1m2f handicap here; never involved over 1m4f at the Curragh since; might find this trip a bit sharp.
runners.comment: Third in a 1m2f handicap here but never involved over 1m4f at the Curragh since
runners.owner: Martin W Walsh & Tony Carey & Brian Murray & Mark Hopkins

runners.name: Kilcrea Rock
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark on 10th start when winning a Dundalk maiden over 10.5f last time; raised 3lb for that but has run well in defeat at this venue before so is one to consider.
runners.comment: Won a Dundalk maiden over 10.5f last time; raised 3lb; has run well in defeat here

runners.name: Apercu
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner up to 1m2.5f; last win came at the Curragh in 2025 off 2lb higher; has been a bit hit and miss since but has faced some stiff tasks too; beaten 6.5l in the Ulster Oaks last time off this mark; needs more.
runners.comment: Five wins; was beaten 6.5l in the Ulster Oaks last time off this mark; needs more

races.race_name: Dubai Racing Carnival Rated Race

runners.name: Keepsgettingbetter
runners.spotlight: Won Dundalk handicaps over 1m and 1m2.5f in the spring; fine efforts in defeat in 1m4f handicaps here and at the Curragh since  behind Darius Dark; up another 2lb but has prospects of staying and a player.
runners.comment: Good runs over 1m4f lately, incl' here; up 2lb; has prospects of staying and a player
runners.owner: Mrs Richard Henry & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Wyman
runners.spotlight: Some promise in both 2yo runs; improved from his seasonal debut here to win a Curragh maiden, both over 1m2f; did well on latter occasion as had to wait for room; takes a major step up in trip today but has prospects of staying.
runners.comment: Won a 1m2f Curragh maiden last time; major step up in trip today but  prospects of staying

runners.name: Lord Aus
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form to win a Limerick handicap over 1m4f last time in first-time cheekpieces (retained); raised 12lb for that but shapes as if this trip is within reach so has to enter calculations.
runners.comment: Raised 12lb for Limerick win; shapes as if this trip is within reach; enters  calculations

runners.name: Handshake
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a German 1000 Guineas winner from a speedy damline; made a winning debut over 1m at Dundalk in January and the runner-up is now rated 78; tongue-tie added now up markedly in trip after a break; still has to be respected.
runners.comment: Won over 1m at Dundalk in January; up markedly in trip but still has to be respected

races.race_name: Turkish Jockey Club Handicap

runners.name: Trubshaw
runners.spotlight: Won twice last term over approx' 1m6f at Sligo and the Curragh; didn't build on solid Navan seasonal bow when well beaten last time at the Curragh; down in grade today and can do better.
runners.comment: Won twice last term over approx' 1m6f; didn't build on seasonal bow last time; do better

runners.name: Tatum
runners.spotlight: Won twice at this track last year over 1m4f/1m5f; the best of three runs this term came back here last time over the longer trip; steps up in trip today and a big player if staying; raised 1lb.
runners.comment: Won twice at this track last year up to 1m5f; fine run again here last time; up in trip

runners.name: Jurality
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Navan over 1m5f and good efforts since over just short of this trip at Bellewstown and Killarney; needs a bit more off this mark.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at Navan and good efforts since; needs a bit more off this mark

runners.name: Folly Beach
runners.spotlight: Her only Flat win in 33 starts came in this race in 2023 on soft ground; best run this year was on soft at Down Royal; has to improve on latest two runs; ground concerns.
runners.comment: Only Flat win came in this race in 2023 on soft; has to improve on latest two runs

runners.name: Friary Road
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper and maiden hurdle winner; some decent Flat runs in six attempts including over C&D last time when he faced a difficult task against some quality rivals; can't be ruled out back in a handicap.
runners.comment: Dual bumper and maiden hurdle winner; some decent Flat runs incl' over C&D last time

runners.name: Party Dress
