runners.comment: Flat winner is 0-15 over hurdles but was second over C&D last time; might not repeat it

runners.name: Rightfolksplease
runners.spotlight: Downpatrick handicap hurdle winner off 89 in 2024 (2m2f, good); signed off his time with Paul Flynn with a poor effort at Musselburgh (2m, good to soft) when last seen in February last year; mammoth absence to overcome in a first-time tongue tie.
runners.comment: Won off 89 in 2024 but has mammoth absence to overcome on stable debut

runners.name: Bella Union
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back winner at Bellewstown (2m1f, yielding) and Down Royal (2m2f, good) in April/May; decent C&D effort on penultimate when a clear runner-up off this mark; pulled up here last time though, so hard to know what to expect now.
runners.comment: Back-to-back winner in April/May ran well over C&D on penultimate but PU here last time

runners.name: Davitts Quay
runners.spotlight: Didn't improve for switch to handicaps over C&D last time when 22l behind, reluctant to race at start; others preferred.
runners.comment: Didn't improve for switch to h'caps last time; others preferred

runners.name: Backinabit
runners.spotlight: First-time blinkers worked the oracle over C&D last time when he left previous poor form behind to win by 3.25l (good); up 6lb but big chance if the headgear retains the same magic.
runners.comment: First-time blinkers worked the oracle over C&D last time; big chance if same effect

runners.name: Mount Hotham
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles and not much encouragement to take from his recent outings.
runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles and not much encouragement to take from his recent outings

runners.name: Ranting And Raven
runners.spotlight: Sixth of 18 over hurdles at Punchestown in May (2m, good to yielding) was her best hurdles run, but she didn't build on that at Limerick last time when tailed off (2m4f, soft); probably best on a sound surface.
runners.comment: P'town sixth in May was best hurdles run; didn't build on that last time on sft ground

runners.name: Boola Times
runners.spotlight: Maiden's best run was when third in a Gowran handicap in October (2m4f, yielding); tailed off at Fairyhouse in December and pulled up on return at Limerick in April (2m4f, soft to heavy)
runners.comment: Tailed off and pulled up in his last two runs, but was third at Gowran in Oct'

races.race_name: Park Run At Wexford Saturday Mornings Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Light Her Up
runners.spotlight: Fair sixth on handicap debut (2m, good to yielding); 2m4f on soft ground didn't suit her at Fairyhouse when last seen in December; the tongue tie returns and the blinkers are new; declared reserve for 7.09 at Ballinrobe on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Fair sixth on h'cap bow but sft didn't suit when last seen in Dec'

runners.name: Tropical Twist
runners.spotlight: Best hurdling effort came over C&D earlier this month when a 4.5l fifth (2m1f, good), keeping on late in the game; could have a part to play and Kennedy is back aboard.
runners.comment: Best effort came over C&D last time when keeping on for fifth; could play a role

runners.name: Del Boys Diva
runners.spotlight: The addition of a tongue tie transformed her at Roscommon (2m, good) last time when running out an easy winner (7l back to Syosset); up 9lb but it was an impressive performance and she likely has more to offer.
runners.comment: A new tongue tie transformed her last time when an easy winner; likely has more to offer

runners.name: Eastern Blue Bird
runners.spotlight: Very modest form so far both over hurdles and on the Flat; beaten 16.5l at Tramore last time on Flat; others more likely.
runners.comment: Modest Flat/hurdles form to date; others more likely

runners.name: Avandra
runners.spotlight: Things picked up when second at Tramore (2m, good) and even though she ran poorly at Sligo next time, her recent outing at Cork also held promise when fifth of 23 (2m2f, good); may get involved.
runners.comment: Good second at Tramore in May; ran to a similar level at Cork last time; may get involved

runners.name: Polly Poppins
runners.spotlight: Maiden and most of her best form has come at Tramore, second over hurdles there in August (2m1f, good) and third over fences in the autumn; back over hurdles after a 22l defeat in a handicap chase here last time; seventh 3.50 here on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Best form has come at Tramore; back over hurdles

runners.name: Liss Eile
runners.spotlight: Only 2.5l away at Tramore (2m, good) but fared less well at Clonmel and Cork since; now 0-8 over hurdles and a visor is reached for.
runners.comment: Only 2.5l away at Tramore but lesser efforts twice since; visor is reached for now

runners.name: Tasmanian Girl
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle at Thurles in March 2025 but undistinguished form outside that; pulled up on her final start for Aengus King over C&D last time; new surroundings need to have had a big effect on her.
runners.comment: Hurdles winner in 2025 but undistinguished form outside that; PU over C&D latest

runners.name: Syosset
runners.spotlight: Has found his form on Flat at Dundalk, winning there in Nov' and running decent races twice afterwards; took that good form and applied it to hurdles when third at Roscommon last time, 7l behind Del Boys Diva; 8lb better off with that rival now; chance.
runners.comment: Beaten 7l in third behind Del Boys Diva last time but 8lb better off with her now; chance

runners.name: Victoria Kesia
runners.spotlight: Flat winner ran her best race over hurdles when a distant third of 14 on handicap hurdle debut at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last month; below that level at Roscommon (2m, good) last time when 21l behind Del Boys Diva.
runners.comment: Flat winner has 21l to find with Del Boys Diva based on their meeting last time

runners.name: Let It Settle
runners.spotlight: Showed moderate form for Gavin Cromwell but the switch of stable appeared to have a big effect on her at Cork last time when second of 23 (2m2f, good, 50-1), making up significant ground from the rear; contender with a repeat.
runners.comment: Switch of stable had a big effect last time when filling second spot; chance with a repeat

runners.name: Glendower
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles and his two runs in handicaps when last seen in this sphere in April/May were not encouraging; some positives in his Flat form this year, but his 27l defeat at Tramore last time was not one of them.
runners.comment: Not much encouragement in five hurdle runs but positives in some of his Flat starts

races.race_name: Save The Date Ladies Day At Wexford Races Friday 7th August INH Flat Race

runners.name: Cotswold Blue
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite and finished second in both starts to date; no excuses when 4.75l behind the winner at Tramore and ran to a similar level when beaten 1.25l over C&D last time; probably worth taking on.
runners.comment: Beaten fav' and finished second in both runs to date; worth taking on

runners.name: Silk Buds
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in sole point but made an eye-catching rules debut at Kelso when travelling strongly and only losing second in the dying strides; didn't build on that when keen at Bellewstown last time.
runners.comment: Good rules debut when losing second in dying strides; didn't build on that last time

runners.name: Pit River
runners.spotlight: Newcomer by the Motivator stallion For Fun, a Grade 1 winner over hurdles in France; cost 24,00euros at two; dam unraced half-sister to French/German 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner; family of smart miler Enrique; check market; declared reserve in 4.36 at Ballinrobe on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Newcomer by the Motivator stallion For Fun; cost 24,00euros at two; check market

runners.name: Distraction
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a Cork maiden hurdle last November, but after a break, was much better in a Tramore bumper despite pulling hard; has a chance and top amateur rider booked but must settle better.
runners.comment: Good effort in a bumper last time despite pulling hard; top rider booked; chance

runners.name: A Quest For Cognac
runners.spotlight: Dam failed to complete in four points, out of German 1m winner; fell at the fourth in her sole point-to-point and that came over a year and a half ago.
runners.comment: Fell at the fourth in her sole point-to-point and that came over a year and a half ago

runners.name: Bambi Fever
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam maiden Flat and jumps, half-sister to 2m hurdle winner Sughera, out of maiden close relative of Dewhurst dead-heater Prince Of Dance; top lady rider aboard but not super appealing on paper.
runners.comment: Top lady rider aboard but not super appealing on paper

runners.name: Ants Fantasy
runners.spotlight: Order of St George gelding; 20,000euros foal; tenth foal; half-brother to French 2m1f chase winner My Vega; dam placed French 2m1f hurdles, half-sister to top-class 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Vautour, out of prolific 7f-1m6f Flat and 1m7f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner; makes belated debut in a hood but has an interesting pedigree; check market.
runners.comment: Order Of St George gelding's dam is a half-sister to top-class Vautour; check market

runners.name: Speisialta
runners.spotlight: Beaten 24l on bumper debut at Punchestown (2m, soft to heavy); refused to race here last time; risky proposition after that but she was just 9-2 that day.
runners.comment: Beaten 24l on debut but just 9-2 when RR here last time; risky proposition

runners.name: Dance Partner
runners.spotlight: Feel Like Dancing gelding; dam 5f winner (RPR 59), half-sister to useful 7f-1m6f winner Profit's Reality, out of 7f winner; not an obvious candidate on breeding.
runners.comment: Dam 5f winner (RPR 59); not an obvious candidate on breeding

runners.name: Piper Street
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to six winners inc Prakasa (German 7f/1m inc 2yo/Group 3; RPR 101), Rippling Waters (1m AW; 82) and Provokator (French 2m1f-2m3f hurdle/chase); dam German 1m2f/1m3f winner; best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to six winners inc Group 3 winner Prakasa (RPR 101); best watched

runners.name: Moses Sport
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to French winners Jena Sport (15.5f) and Irish Sport (2m3f hurdle); dam French 1m2f-1m4f winner (RPR 86); trainer 1-13 in bumpers last five seasons.
runners.comment: Half-brother to French Flat/hurdle winners; dam French 1m2f-1m4f winner

runners.name: Nancy Wheeler
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Roscommon on debut; unlike to feature.
runners.comment: Tailed off at Roscommon on debut; unlike to feature

runners.name: Treacys Ella
runners.spotlight: First reserve; well beaten on bumper debut at Sligo (2m2f, good); tongue tie goes on now, but others preferred.
runners.comment: Reserve; well beaten on bumper debut; others preferred

runners.name: Gusserane
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; failed to complete either point-to-point and was beaten 24l on bumper debut at Listowel.
runners.comment: Reserve; failed to complete either point and beaten 24l on bumper debut

runners.name: Bredas Pearl
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on debut at Hexham (2m, soft, 4-1); others preferred.
runners.comment: Well beaten on debut at Hexham (2m, soft, 4-1); others preferred

races.race_name: Follow BetVictor On Instagram Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Duke Of Burgundy
runners.spotlight: Built upon promising debut when finishing well to collar a subsequent winner at Kempton (7f, AW) last month; did that quite cosily in the end and could easily have more improvement to come in nurseries back on turf.
runners.comment: Finished well to win quite cosily in the end at Kempton last month; nursery debut today

runners.name: Metamouse
runners.spotlight: Swooped on the outside for comfortable success in Chester novice (6f, good to soft) last month, his second start, and seemed to cope with the much faster ground when respectable fourth at Salisbury (6f, good to firm; 1.5l behind Flying Pirate but now 3lb better off) on latest outing; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Won at Chester last month; closely matched with Flying Pirate on Salisbury form

runners.name: Flying Pirate
runners.spotlight: Scored on debut at Salisbury (6f, soft) in June and also ran well when third in quite valuable conditions race over that C&D (good to firm) three weeks later; upped in trip for nursery debut, having recently been gelded; ought to make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Launched career with two good 6f runs at Salisbury; up in trip for nursery debut

runners.name: Victory Gold
runners.spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise and looked suited by the step up in trip when making all in Lingfield novice (7f, AW) this month; returns to turf for this nursery debut; likely contender again.
runners.comment: Made all when upped to 7f for Lingfield AW novice this month; likely contender

runners.name: Waasil
runners.spotlight: Travelled strongly before asserting in pretty good style at Beverley (7.4f, good; third a recent winner) last month, his second start; the only runner from Karl Burke's North Yorkshire stable on this card; needs to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: Won Beverley novice in good style last month and needs to be taken very seriously

races.race_name: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Art Of Life
runners.spotlight: Out of a Group-placed 6f 2yo winner and made quite promising debut when sixth of 13 here (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely to play a significant role if able to build on that performance.
runners.comment: Made quite promising debut when sixth of 13 here this month; shortlisted

runners.name: Blue Corn
runners.spotlight: 86,000euros yearling; first foal; dam runner-up 7f/1m AW (RPR 68), half-sister to winners Emperor Claudius (1m Listed), Dark Lochnagar (1m1f 2yo/1m2f) and Dove Mountain (7f-1m2f), out of 1,000 Guineas winner Virginia Waters; market may guide.
runners.comment: First foal from a daughter of 1,000 Guineas winner Virginia Waters; market helpful

runners.name: Lorraine
runners.spotlight: Second foal; sister to Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner Publish (RPR 96); dam US 1m-1m1f turf winner (including Grade 2; 106), sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winners Arizona; with a top stable and looks the part on paper.
runners.comment: Out of a US Grade 2 winner; with a top stable and looks the part on paper

runners.name: Lady Miranda
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced when seventh in good Newmarket maiden (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago, her second run, but needs to improve again here.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in good Newmarket maiden this month but needs to improve again here

runners.name: Moda Rosa
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns foal; first foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners Divine Unicorn (Australian 1m3f Group 3) and Measuring Time (useful 7f 2yo), out of disqualified 1m 2yo winner/Oaks fourth; the other three newcomers look more interesting.
runners.comment: 5,000gns foal; the other three newcomers look more interesting

runners.name: Ruby Sands
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; sister to 6f/7f 2yo winner Ellaria Sand (incuding Listed; RPR 97), half-sister to 5f AW 2yo winner Ba'Hoa (76); dam 6f AW winner (79), half-sister to useful winners Rekdhat (7f/1m including 2yo) and Ajaadat (7.4f/1m including 2yo); has the right type of pedigree for this race.
runners.comment: Sister to a useful 6f/7f 2yo winner; has the right type of pedigree for this race

runners.name: Dark Reign
runners.spotlight: Out of a very well-connected mare but was towards the rear throughout her debut at Kempton (7f, AW) six weeks ago and needs to take a big step forward here.
runners.comment: Out of a very well-connected mare but was towards the rear throughout her debut
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

races.race_name: Country & Town House Handicap

runners.name: Silver Wraith
runners.spotlight: Made all off today's mark on seasonal debut at Bath (5.7f, firm) in April and will be fine over this slightly longer trip but doesn't always looks straightforward and needs to up her game after two below-par 5f runs.
runners.comment: Made all off this mark in April but recent 5f form has been disappointing

runners.name: Phoenix Moon
runners.spotlight: 4-13 on AW but 0-11 on turf; had soft ground as an excuse last time, though, and has each-way claims at least if judged on her second at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May.
runners.comment: 0-11 on turf but has each-way claims at least if judged on Windsor second in May

runners.name: Raffles Angel
runners.spotlight: Bettered disappointing seasonal debut when third of five at Nottingham (6f, good) last month and is now 1lb lower than when winning from off the pace at Haydock (6f, good) last summer; no surprise if she features.
runners.comment: Ran okay at Nottingham in June and has now dipped below last summer's winning mark

runners.name: Eightthreeone
runners.spotlight: Scored on seasonall/handicap debut at Southwell (6f, AW) in April and made the frame three consecutive times on turf (5f-6f) afterwards; didn't fire last time but remains quite lightly raced; contender if back on song.
runners.comment: Didn't fire last time but made strong start to season beforehand and is not yet exposed

runners.name: Always Perfect
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo who opened her account in five-runner Yarmouth handicap (6f, good to firm) last month, her fifth start; 5lb higher in a deeper race here but should still have more to offer; high on the list.
runners.comment: Progressive 3yo who opened her account at Yarmouth last month; high on the list

runners.name: Distant Rumble
runners.spotlight: Sightly disappointing after sluggish start at Newmarket this month but returned to turf with three good runs this spring, the most notable a win at Windsor (6f, good to firm) on second occasion; features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Not quite at best last time but this spring's form makes him a major player

runners.name: Just Jump
runners.spotlight: Quirky 4yo with who often starts slowly and/or races too freely, and refused to race three outings ago; did well to win at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last month and will be suited by this return to 6f but others are much less risky.
runners.comment: Did well to win two starts ago but this quirky 4yo comes with risks attached

runners.name: Mumayaz
runners.spotlight: Still 4lb higher than when winning at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May but has been pretty consistent since rejoining Tony Carroll in March and probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Won in May and has otherwise been pretty consistent since rejoining this yard in March

runners.name: Waistcoat
runners.spotlight: Made good progress last year, collecting four 6f wins along the way, but made nothing better than a satisfactory reappearance in May and is still on a fairly tough mark for this first run since.
runners.comment: Won four times in 2025 but absent since low-key reappearance run in May

races.race_name: Newbury Racecourse Resident DJ, Moonraker Disco Handicap

runners.name: Campeona
runners.spotlight: Clear second when upped to 11.6f for seasonal/handicap debut at Bath this month and won readily over 1m6f there (again on firm) last week; carries 6lb penalty (due to go up by that amount anyway) here but probably still has more improvement to come; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Came good with ready win at Bath last week; commands respect under 6lb penalty

runners.name: Diamond Bay
runners.spotlight: Regressive 8yo who has not been firing on all cylinders this season and was beaten over 14l when fourth of five at Lingfield (2m, good) last month; continues to slide down the weights but needs a revival.
runners.comment: Regressive 8yo who has not been firing on all cylinders this season; revival needed

runners.name: The Craftymaster
runners.spotlight: Prolific AW winner, most recently when darting 14l clear at Wolverhampton (2m) last month; narrowly exploited lower turf mark at Lingfield (2m, good to firm) last night and, even under a penalty, remains well treated on his AW exploits; will enter calculations if he runs.
runners.comment: Prolific AW winner; exploited lower turf mark at Lingfield last night; enters calculations
runners.owner: R Miles, V Miles, T Stamp & Partner

runners.name: Golden Flame
runners.spotlight: Nothing like the force of old but won comfortably on seasonal debut at Ffos Las (2m, good; first win since 2021) last month, despite refusing to settle in early stages; only second when odds-on to follow up in four-runner race at Doncaster (1m6f, good to firm; again raced too freely) soon afterwards but at least we know he's in good nick.
runners.comment: Won off much-reduced mark last month, despite refusing to settle; should go well again

races.race_name: Rayner Bosch Car Service Handicap

runners.name: Sarangpur
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo who started off for Richard Hughes with emphatic 1m4f turf wins at Brighton (good to firm) and Epsom (good) this summer; lost out narrowly when odds-on at Kempton (1m3f, AW) two weeks ago, having been forced to make his own running in a tactical race, but remains of strong interest.
runners.comment: Started off for this stable with two emphatic wins this summer; remains of strong interest

runners.name: Nowshesdancing
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who made winning debut in AW in Ireland in January (10.6f) and posted best of three runs for new stable when third of seven on last month's handicap debut at Goodwood (1m4f, good), form recently well advertised by the winner.
runners.comment: Ran well when third on last month's handicap debut at Goodwood, and remains lightly raced

runners.name: Dancing Tiger
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who scored on seasonal debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to soft) and has gone close on last two appearances; drew nicely clear of the others with next-time-out winner at Goodwood (1m4f, good to soft) last month and is only 2lb higher here (due to go up another 2lb soon) but needs to prove himself on the faster ground.
runners.comment: Clear with next-time-out winner when close second in June; may find this ground too lively

runners.name: Into Battle
runners.spotlight: Not seen on the Flat since signing off for Ed Walker with narrow success in first-time blinkers at Salisbury (1m2f, good) in October but won a recent handicap hurdle for new connections (no headgear) and is unexposed over this sort of trip in this sphere.
runners.comment: Not since on the Flat since narrow win in October but scored recently over hurdles

races.race_name: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Raintown
runners.spotlight: Has much better strike-rate on AW but has performed well on fast turf here twice in recent weeks (1m3f/1m2f) and is still on a workable mark.
runners.comment: Has much better strike-rate on AW but has run well here twice in recent weeks
runners.owner: Ms Caroline Instone & J S Moore

runners.name: One Cool Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Went close at Wolverhampton (1m6f, AW) for Alan King in February but dropped out quite tamely on recent stable debut (2m, AW) and this shorter trip may not be ideal for him nowadays.
runners.comment: Dropped out quite tamely on stable debut and may need further than 1m2f nowadays

runners.name: Just An Hour
runners.spotlight: Consistent 6yo who was beaten under 1l when fourth of eight at Chester (extended 1m4f, good) 12 days ago and will be fine over this shorter trip; likely to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Consistent 6yo who was beaten under 1l when fourth at Chester recently; in the mix again

runners.name: Baloo's Blues
runners.spotlight: Came good at ninth attempt, when back on turf at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) last month; nudged up only 2lb for that and remains unexposed over this trip; big player if aided by new tongue-tie and/or cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Came good at Lingfield last month and remains unexposed over this trip

runners.name: Port Louis
runners.spotlight: Belied 50-1 odds when second of 22 under Chelsea Edwards at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in March and put some poor efforts behind him when third at Ffos Las (1m, good; refitted cheekpieces) last month but is not easy to predict and has stamina to prove over this new trip.
runners.comment: Returned to form in refitted cheekpieces last month but is not easy to predict

runners.name: Caph Star
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who was creditable third of 14 under Harry Rimell in stronger race than this at York (extended 1m2f, good) last month; good chance off same mark here, assuming he handles the faster ground.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 7yo; creditable third off this mark under Harry Rimell at York last month

runners.name: Zambezi Magic
runners.spotlight: Gained his last four wins on heavy ground at Ffos Las (1m-1m2f); handles fast ground but is yet to strike form after three runs this season and might still be too high in the weights.
runners.comment: Best known as a heavy-ground specialist at Ffos Las nowadays; opposable here

runners.name: Lerwick
runners.spotlight: Began this year with three respectable 7f AW runs in blinkers (missing today) and can also be effective over 1m2f on turf but has fitness to prove after 145-day break and his last win came in summer 2024.
runners.comment: Began year with three respectable 7f AW runs but has fitness to prove here

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Timely Affair
runners.spotlight: Effective over C&D but his two wins this year have come over 1m on this track; has remained in form on turf since the latest of them in April and he shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Effective over C&D but both wins over 1m on this track; remains in form; thereabouts

runners.name: Anthropologist
runners.spotlight: Both AW wins at Newcastle (1m and 7f) but he lost out only narrowly over C&D in March; has had ups and downs since but he came from well back when fourth of ten to Gunfighter over C&D recently; place chance.
runners.comment: Back to form when never-nearer 4th to Gunfighter over C&D last time; place chance

runners.name: Fan Mail
runners.spotlight: Two 6f wins on Tapeta in 2025 and he's had just three goes at this trip, all on turf; he didn't do badly when fourth on Carlisle's stiff track last time out so perhaps he's worth another shot at 7f, albeit his AW mark is 5lb higher than on turf.
runners.comment: Both AW wins over 6f; three turf runs at 7f and not disgraced latest; has higher AW mark
runners.owner: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr

runners.name: Shamacid
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 14 starts; very slowly away two starts ago but otherwise has possibilities, having run most of his best races on Tapeta and was hampered in his run over C&D last time; may well be involved.
runners.comment: 0-14 but has run several good races on Tapeta and was hampered over C&D last time

runners.name: Dannick
runners.spotlight: Took his time about getting off the mark but he did so in good style on Lingfield AW (7f) ten days ago and, although back up 9lb, he went close off this mark at Ascot last September; also has form over this C&D (one attempt); solid claims.
runners.comment: Off the mark over 7f on AW latest; back up 9lb but weighted to go well; has form over C&D

runners.name: Portman Blue
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced; has shown enough on Polytrack to think he can find a race before long but he was well held in his first Tapeta handicap, over C&D recently, in first-time tongue-tie; will need more today.
runners.comment: Lightly raced; can find a race but was well held over C&D latest in first Tapeta handicap

runners.name: Wish This
runners.spotlight: Broke duck over 6f on Newcastle AW last November but he hasn't run to the same level at that trip or 7f this year; has it to prove at present.
runners.comment: Broke duck over 6f on AW last November but not in the same form at that trip or 7f in 2026

runners.name: Triggerman
runners.spotlight: Sole win came over 1m here in 2024; on a useful mark at present but has a question mark about current form, having dropped out on his final start for previous yard and on debut for this one, at Chester 13 days ago.
runners.comment: Useful mark but he dropped out on final start for previous yard and on debut for this one

runners.name: Finn Ironside
runners.spotlight: Front-runs; all three wins at 7f, the latest on Newcastle AW last August; probably found the return to 1m was pushing it on Kempton AW 15 days ago but he ran well for a long way and this test will work better for him.
runners.comment: Front-runs; creditable show over 1m latest; this test will work better for him

runners.name: Red Mirage
runners.spotlight: All four AW wins on Polytrack, the latest more than four years ago, and he's likely to need more than a respectable sixth at Newcastle in May, when having a rare run on Tapeta, and also on his Chester form since; headgear returns for the first time since last July.
runners.comment: AW wins on Polytrack; rarely runs on Tapeta; needs more than recent Newcastle/Chester runs

runners.name: Blazing Son
runners.spotlight: Five AW wins include two on this course (at 6f; has won over 7f) but he's been going through a quieter spell of late; others more likely.
runners.comment: Five AW wins include two on this course but he's been quieter of late; others more likely

runners.name: Avatar Jet
runners.spotlight: Had 7f form in Ireland but that was two years ago and his course win came over 1m in April (made all) on second start for this yard; no advance on that form in two runs since but perhaps the return to this trip will improve his options.
runners.comment: Had 7f form in Ireland two years ago; won over 1m here in April; worth another go at 7f

runners.name: Pursuit Of Truth
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since getting off the mark on Wolverhampton AW (about 1m1f) last June, dropping out there 16 days ago for another new yard; has plenty to prove in his first 7f handicap.
runners.comment: Won on Wolverhampton AW (1m1f) in 2025; lightly raced since; this is his first 7f handicap

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)

runners.name: Foxy Night
runners.spotlight: Beaten three times but she sets the standard on her thirds at Carlisle (1m, soft) and Ffos Las (extended 7f, good); last time she was clear of the rest behind two promising horses.
runners.comment: Beaten three times but she sets the standard on her thirds at Carlisle and Ffos Las

runners.name: Burning Impact
runners.spotlight: 155,000gns yearling by Too Darn Hot; 28-1, he showed promise behind a talented stablemate over 1m here a month ago (beaten a shade under 7l); can improve; tongue-tie goes on.
runners.comment: 28-1, he showed promise behind a talented stablemate over 1m here a month ago

runners.name: Hulk Power
runners.spotlight: Night Of Thunder colt who cost 100,000gns as a yearling and 580,000euros at a breeze-up sale; half-brother to seven winners including Via Serendipity (7f-8.6f; RPR 111), Strong Chemistry (7f; 107) and Le Juge (1m-1m2f; 106); dam 7f/1m Listed winner (101); lots to like on paper and the market can guide as to expectations on debut.
runners.comment: Lots to like on paper and the market can guide as to expectations on debut

runners.name: Real Trouper
runners.spotlight: Ran okay when beaten 8.5l in a warm race at York (1m) but Newcastle (7f) was disappointing; not without hope if tapping back into the promise of that initial run.
runners.comment: Promising third at York (beaten 8.5l) but Newcastle (7f) was disappointing
runners.owner: Peter Onslow, FDC Holdings Ltd & NWIR Ltd

runners.name: Thairish
runners.spotlight: From a good family, being a half-sister to useful middle-distance/hurdles winner Redicean and smart Haunted Dream, among others; may ultimately want more of a stamina test.
runners.comment: From a good family but may ultimately want more of a stamina test

runners.name: Inspectre
runners.spotlight: 4,000euros foal; fifth foal; half-brother to Bahraini 7f winner Yuan Prince; dam 7f winner (RPR 71), sister to 5f Group 1 winner Move In Time; gelded ahead of this debut and a hood is fitted; not that appealing.
runners.comment: 4,000euros foal; gelded ahead of this debut and a hood is fitted

runners.name: Walking On Stars
runners.spotlight: By Sea The Stars; first foal; dam German 1m3f winner (Group 3; RPR 106), half-sister to French 1m4f winner Waugh; bred to be above average and the market should be informative.
runners.comment: By Sea The Stars; first foal; dam German 1m3f winner (Group 3; RPR 106); market useful
runners.owner: Gestuet Schlenderhan Gmbh U Co Kg

runners.name: Lady Fizz
runners.spotlight: Has performed to an ordinary level thus far and handicaps will be more like it.
runners.comment: Has performed to an ordinary level thus far and handicaps will be more like it

runners.name: Gallant Pioneer
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 12l into midfield at Wolverhampton last month (7f) where he didn't get the clearest of passages; still makes limited appeal.
runners.comment: Beaten about 12l into midfield at Wolverhampton last month (7f)

runners.name: Rogue Federation
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two runs for James Owen and was sold on for 1,000gns.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two runs for James Owen and was sold on for 1,000gns

runners.name: Baareq
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling by Bated Breath; a weak 16-1 chance when finishing a remote sixth at Windsor (1m, good to soft); has to show more.
runners.comment: A weak 16-1 chance when finishing a remote sixth at Windsor; has to show more

runners.name: Thunder Rush
runners.spotlight: Down the field in 1m/7f races at Newcastle, the latest in early May; no appeal.
runners.comment: Down the field in 1m/7f races at Newcastle, the latest in early May; no appeal

runners.name: Moral Victory
runners.spotlight: Finished last on debut here and again at Thirsk, both times over 1m; no appeal.
runners.comment: Finished last on debut here and again at Thirsk, both times over 1m; no appeal

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)

runners.name: Conspiracist
runners.spotlight: Well related; showed plenty more on his second visit to Kempton (7f) when only 2l behind a Ralph Beckett-trained winner; this colt raced prominently before weakening; solid chance on the back of that.
runners.comment: Solid chance after showing improved form second time out at Kempton (beaten 2l)

runners.name: Dovecote
runners.spotlight: Gelded after a very quiet debut last November and duly showed lots more when just run out of it at Lingfield (extended 7f, soft) having been given every chance; that wasn't a strong race despite the winner following up in a handicap, but neither is this.
runners.comment: Gelded ahead of reappearance and was only just run out of it at Lingfield
runners.owner: A D G Oldrey & G C Hartigan

runners.name: For Ever Hopefull
runners.spotlight: They all finished in a bit of a heap when this filly was only 2.5l off the winner here 18 days ago; ran well for a 250-1 chance but probably needs more here.
runners.comment: They all finished in a bit of a heap when only 2.5l off the winner here 18 days ago

runners.name: Protectrix
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to five winners including Earls Rock (US 6.5f-8.5f; Grade 3; RPR 107), Lady La Fay (11.4f/1m4f; 94) and Cash Or Crypto (6f; 88); dam 7.4f/1m winner (97); trainer-owned newcomer; others preferred.
runners.comment: Half-sister to five winners; trainer-owned newcomer; others preferred

runners.name: League Of Justice
runners.spotlight: High-class US pedigree and cost 250,000euros at a 2yo breeze-up sale; however, changed hands again for 6,000gns this April; a watching brief is best.
runners.comment: Cost 250,000euros at a 2yo breeze-up sale; sold on for 6,000gns this April

runners.name: Heaven's Hope
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to 5.7f winner Malham Tarn Cove (RPR 57); dam 5f/6f winner (68); kicks off at 7f despite his speedy pedigree; limited appeal.
runners.comment: Kicks off at 7f despite his speedy pedigree; limited appeal

runners.name: Ze Gucci Poochie
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to five winners including Free Love (5f; RPR 92), Lydia's Place (5f; 90), Lawless Louis (5f-6f; 81) and Dimitar (7f/1m; 76); dam 5f 2yo winner (74); gelded ahead of debut; one to watch more than likely.
runners.comment: Half-brother to five winners; gelded ahead of debut; one to watch more than likely

runners.name: Gran Ventura
runners.spotlight: Australian-bred filly by Frankel; had one run in these colours for George Boughey when beaten a little under 10l in a warm 1m novice for fillies at Newmarket just over a year ago; second run has been a long time coming but she has ability.
runners.comment: With George Boughey when beaten just under 10l in a warm Newmarket race last year

runners.name: Rake Lane
runners.spotlight: Insufficient promise in her first two races to warrant a second look in this.
runners.comment: Insufficient promise in her first two races to warrant a second look in this

runners.name: Cosmic Bond
runners.spotlight: Trailed the winner by about 20l on 7f debut at Wolverhampton two weeks ago (250-1).
runners.comment: Trailed the winner by about 20l on 7f debut at Wolverhampton two weeks ago (250-1)

runners.name: Pure Passion
runners.spotlight: Respectable runs at Chelmsford and here but hard to rate her form too highly and she's stepping up from 5f.
runners.comment: Respectable runs at Chelmsford and here (both at 5f) but hard to rate her form too highly
runners.owner: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells

runners.name: Morty Robinson
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to 6f/7f winner Deposer (RPR 112); this is a very belated debut at six and can only be watched.
runners.comment: This is a very belated debut at six and can only be watched

runners.name: Ridger
runners.spotlight: Last of six on debut and a tailed-off last of nine last week at Wolverhampton (first-time hood).
runners.comment: Last of six on debut and a tailed-off last of nine last week at Wolverhampton (hooded)

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners.name: Rlasthope
runners.spotlight: All four starts in Class 2 company, including when beaten a neck by the subsequent Lily Agnes winner Adonius at Musselburgh (5f, good to soft) in April and when third of 13 in the Woodcote at Epsom (6f, good to soft) last month; high draw one small negative, but he is in much calmer waters here and his four winning siblings and his dam were all successful on the AW; should be hard to beat.
runners.comment: All four starts in Class 2 company and has run well in all of them; should be hard to beat

runners.name: Beresford Gap
runners.spotlight: Improved plenty from his debut effort when beaten just over a length into third of 18 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; half-brother and dam both won on the AW and any further improvement will make him a big player.
runners.comment: Improved from his debut effort when third of 18 at Newbury a fortnight ago; big player

runners.name: Excessive
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise when fourth of eight on last month's Carlisle debut (5f, good to soft), but the form hasn't worked out and he himself was well held at Pontefract (6f, good) 12 days later; has the outside stall and may be one for nurseries.
runners.comment: Went backwards from a mildly promising debut; may be one for nurseries

runners.name: Dreamlighter
runners.spotlight: 25-1 when seventh of ten on his Ayr debut (7f, good) this month; improvement needed, though he is a half-brother to two AW winners and his sire has a good record around here.
runners.comment: Well held on Ayr debut, but may improve for the switch to this surface

runners.name: Harry's Pop
runners.spotlight: Some ability in his first two starts, but failed to beat a rival at Bath (5.7f, firm) this month (reportedly hung violently right-handed); gelding operation will need to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Some ability in first two starts, but hung violently right-handed last time; gelded since
runners.owner: K Shenton, N Bradley 6 & D Cunha

runners.name: Backmeifyoucan
runners.spotlight: February foal by Starspangledbanner; 20,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners La Ferveur (French 8.5f; RPR 88) and Impelling (Czech 6.5f); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (94), half-sister to Italian 5f Listed winner Gamgoom, out of half-sister to 5f Group 1 winner Profitable; already gelded and would be a very rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard.
runners.comment: Already gelded and would be a very rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard

runners.name: L B Double U
runners.spotlight: April foal by Calyx; 25,000euros yearling; half-brother to six winners including Whispering Bell (1m; RPR 90), Stardayz (1m AW; 81), Unsung Hero (7f AW; 78) and Beauty Nation (6f AW 2yo; 78); dam placed 5f 2yo (72), half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Newfangled; sire has a good record here and stable does have winning 2yo newcomers; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Sire has good record here and stable does have winning 2yo newcomers; worth a market check

runners.name: Athos
runners.spotlight: Faced an impossible task on last month's York debut as things turned out, but did hint at ability when fifth of ten at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) 12 days later; not sure dropping back in trip is ideal, though, and nurseries over further may see him in a better light.
runners.comment: Showed some ability on second start, but not sure dropping back in trip is ideal

runners.name: Celita Star
runners.spotlight: Held in her first two starts at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) and Ripon (6f, good), but showed a glimmer of ability on each occasion; out of a Listed winner, but nurseries may be a more suitable option after this.
runners.comment: Showed a glimmer of ability in both starts, but nurseries may be a more suitable option

runners.name: Stoney Wood
runners.spotlight: Nice pedigree but well held in 6f maidens at Windsor (good to firm) and Kempton (Polytrack) last month; nurseries beckon.
runners.comment: Well held in maidens at Windsor and Kempton last month; nurseries beckon

runners.name: Champagne Charlee
runners.spotlight: Completely blew the start when last of nine on his debut in a Leicester seller (6f, good to firm; 11-1) this month; needs a sizeable step forward.
runners.comment: Completely blew the start when last on his Leicester debut; needs a sizeable step forward

runners.name: Therewearethen
runners.spotlight: 25-1 when last of nine on his Newcastle debut (7f, Tapeta) four weeks ago; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Last of nine on his Newcastle debut four weeks ago; look elsewhere

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners.name: Too Many Spirits
runners.spotlight: Hasn't stepped up from his narrow defeat at Pontefract (5f, good) on his second start in April, albeit 7f may have stretched him at Ayr last time; has still shown enough to make the shortlist, though, with his half-brother and dam both successful on the AW.
runners.comment: Has shown ability in four starts on turf and bred to handle to AW; shortlisted

runners.name: Enamored
runners.spotlight: Missed the break but still showed plenty of promise when third of ten on her Yarmouth debut (6f, good to firm; 33-1) five weeks ago (fifth has won since); wouldn't want to lose too much ground from the inside stall here, but still a major player granted normal progress.
runners.comment: Plenty of promise when third on her Yarmouth debut; major player granted normal progress

runners.name: Little Mester
runners.spotlight: 50-1 when beaten 2l into fourth of nine on this month's Leicester debut (6f, good to firm); that was only a seller, though, and others are preferred even though the third has won since.
runners.comment: Beaten 2l into fourth in a Leicester seller on debut; others are preferred

runners.name: Bella Lucia
runners.spotlight: Surrounded by subsequent winners when third of 11 on her Beverley debut (5f, good to soft) in May, but disappointed at Redcar (6f, good to firm) later in month; her dam won four times on the Fibresand here and she would have to be respected if building on that first effort.
runners.comment: Disappointed second time after a promising debut; dam won four times on Fibresand here

runners.name: Purple Dream
runners.spotlight: April foal by Dream Ahead; half-sister to winners Miss Mai Tai (6f-1m including 2yo/France/Czechia; RPR 89), Miss Woo Woo (6f-7.5f including 2yo/AW/France/Belgium; 76) and Sands Of Seve (5f AW; 57); dam once-raced (52) half-sister to Swedish 5f-1m winner Sweet Loreen; would be a very rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard.
runners.comment: Would be a very rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard

runners.name: Steamy Wonder
runners.spotlight: March foal by Belardo; 2,000gns yearling; dam unraced half-sister to winners Day Of Conquest (useful 7f/1m 2yo), Day By Day (useful 5f/6f) and Alexander Ballet (5f; dam of 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Hearts of Fire); stable has few 2yos go in first time while the outside stall may prove tricky for a newcomer.
runners.comment: Stable has few 2yos go in first time; the outside stall may prove tricky for a newcomer

runners.name: Honeymoon Bear
runners.spotlight: 25-1 when finishing in midfield behind the subsequent Super Sprint winner Zigazig Ah on last month's Yarmouth debut (6f, good to firm); needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Finished in midfield on last month's Yarmouth debut; needs to take a step forward

runners.name: Tzaritza
runners.spotlight: Had excuses for her Wetherby debut, but less so for her Newbury effort (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Had excuses for her debut effort, but not on her second start; best watched for now

runners.name: Time And Effort
runners.spotlight: Some ability when fourth of seven on her Musselburgh debut (5f, good) in May, but was completely out of her depth in the Woodcote at Epsom (6f, good to soft) last month; two of her siblings and her dam won on the AW, but nurseries may be a better fit after this.
runners.comment: Some ability on debut but out of her depth on second start; nurseries may be a better fit

runners.name: Good Fighter
runners.spotlight: Well held in novices at Windsor (5f, good to firm) and Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last month; one of his winning half-sisters and his dam were successful on the AW, but best watched for now.
runners.comment: Well held in two turf novices last month; best watched for now

runners.name: Terryfying
runners.spotlight: 40-1 when well beaten on this month's Thirsk debut (6f, good to firm); stable's newcomers are usually better for a run, but he needs plenty of improvement.
runners.comment: Well beaten on this month's Thirsk debut; needs plenty of improvement

runners.name: Banter Inn Court
runners.spotlight: 16-1 when beating only one home on his Leicester debut (5f, good to firm) in May; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Beat only one home on his Leicester debut in May; hard to recommend

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Belle Of Kt
runners.spotlight: Sole win (13 races) came over 1m4f in a classified on Wolverhampton Tapeta in March; third in classifieds on three of her four starts since, with recent form not looking quite good enough to win this handicap but she raced wide last time and peak efforts give her a shout.
runners.comment: Recent form not good enough, but raced wide last time and peak efforts give her a shout

runners.name: Lednikov
runners.spotlight: Often a front-runner and gained the last six of his seven wins on this Southwell AW, with the latest win in March; Elle-May Croot knows him especially well, he's back to his last winning mark and return to Southwell (latest run here was five starts ago) might spark something.
runners.comment: The last six of his seven wins were on this Southwell AW, with the latest win in March

runners.name: Koko Blue
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; third off this career-low mark over about 1m4f at Windsor and Brighton in her two starts for new yard, which puts her in each-way calculations even though she tailed off (2m in December) in her only start on Tapeta.
runners.comment: Tailed off (2m in December) in her only start on Tapeta; third on turf on last two starts

runners.name: Quirke On Parole
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; sole win from 13 races was at Beverley (1m2f) in June 2025 off 4lb higher; out of sorts this season and although her latest start was a step back in the right direction, this first run beyond 1m2f poses an additional question.
runners.comment: Latest start was step back in the right direction; first run beyond 1m2f poses a question
runners.owner: A Quirke & Mrs G B Walford

runners.name: Late Claim
runners.spotlight: Ridden by Finlay Bassett on last eight outings; sole win from 17 starts came on her handicap debut at Lingfield (1m5f, AW) in December; runner-up on three of her next four starts, including here, but not so good in recent races and needs to perk up again.
runners.comment: Has been runner-up here but not so good in recent races and needs to perk up again

runners.name: Urban Warrior
runners.spotlight: Edging down the weights and this six-race maiden has taken minor honours in his three handicaps (two 1m6f and one at 1m2f); first of those was on Wolverhampton Tapeta; considered.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden; took minor honours in his three handicaps (two 1m6f and one at 1m2f)
runners.owner: W Enticknap, B Ralph And Partner

runners.name: Saachi
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m4f AW classified at Wolverhampton in March and so nearly won another at Lingfield 15 days later; pulled up over hurdles in May on his only start since but a return to form can't be ruled out, so neither can he.
runners.comment: Won and beaten a nose on last two Flat runs (AW classified); pulled up over hurdles in May

runners.name: Night Bear
runners.spotlight: Only one win (June 2024) in the last four seasons; there have been some close calls this year, including at this track in January and at Brighton on penultimate start, so he has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Only one win (June 2024) in the last four seasons; some close calls this year

runners.name: Dissident
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner in first-time blinkers; 0-11 on the Flat, which sees him continue down the weights but he's been soundly beaten in Polytrack handicaps (unraced on Tapeta) and Flat record over the last year has been uninspiring; visored first time (has tried cheekpieces as well as the blinkers).
runners.comment: Flat record over the last year has been uninspiring; different headgear this time

runners.name: Zucayan
runners.spotlight: Gained all three of his wins over hurdles at Ludlow (in May 2022, 2023 and 2025); twice second there before falling on latest start, seven weeks ago; lightly raced on Flat, without registering any solid form but they were all with either very different trip and/or surface to today's.
runners.comment: Lightly raced on Flat, with no solid form but all were very different trip and/or surface

races.race_name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap

runners.name: Hansteen
runners.spotlight: Revealed little in his qualifying runs over much shorter trips but he lost out only near the line on handicap debut over 1m4f at Ripon before overpowering his rivals in a classified event at Pontefract (1m4f, good to firm) last week; goes unpenalised and is due a 5lb rise in future; now having first run on sand but dam has bred two AW winners; good claims.
runners.comment: Close 2nd on handicap debut (1m4f); well clear latest; unpenalised and 5lb well in

runners.name: Smoker Bellamy
runners.spotlight: In the frame three times since leaving maiden and novice company, including in 1m4f classified on Lingfield AW recently; this slightly shorter trip could help back on Tapeta but more needed; cheekpieces refitted.
runners.comment: Fair fourth in 1m4f classified latest; slightly shorter trip could suit; more needed

runners.name: Lordsbridge Bay
runners.spotlight: Some early promise over 7f and 1m on the AW this spring but it's been hard work for him in handicaps on AW and turf, in headgear on last two starts, and he has lots to find now taking a big step up in trip.
runners.comment: Some early promise but it's been hard work in 1m/7f handicaps; lots to find over new trip

runners.name: Alcanzor
runners.spotlight: Little of note in novice and maiden events and seemingly little expected on handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm; 25-1) this month when he was never involved; much more needed for new cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Little of note so far, including on handicap debut (1m2f; 25-1); cheekpieces on

runners.name: N'Ion
runners.spotlight: Nothing to latch on to as yet in just four starts and the writing was on the wall a long way out on handicap debut at Windsor (about 1m3f; 66-1) in May; wore cheekpieces that day but they're left off now; others more likely.
runners.comment: Nothing to latch on to as yet and beaten a long way out on handicap debut; lots to find

runners.name: Galistra
runners.spotlight: Beaten 13l+ in first three runs for Ralph Beckett and this yard and she ran no race at all on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW; 50-1) last week; can only watch.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten all 4 runs, running no race at all on handicap debut (1m4f, AW) last week

runners.name: Summer Oasis
runners.spotlight: Dam bred one who was successful at 1m2f on AW but most of this one's pedigree leans towards shorter trips and she's no good thing to improve on her handful of starts at up to 1m now right up in distance; cheekpieces on.
runners.comment: Minor form at up to 1m; no good thing on pedigree to improve for step up to 1m3f

runners.name: Arc At Her
runners.spotlight: Minor form as yet and her stamina for this far has to be proved following two weak finishes over 1m2f on turf, dropping to a classified event at Nottingham (first-time cheekpieces, retained) on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Far from sure to stay 1m3f after two weak finishes over 1m2f on turf, latest on Tuesday
runners.owner: Gee Gee's Racing & Hold My Beer

runners.name: Saxophonic
runners.spotlight: Looked likely to benefit from a step up in trip when running best race for previous yard over 1m2f on Newcastle AW in February; however, was well held on yard debut at Kempton (1m4f, AW) and he just plugged on at one pace at Windsor (about 1m3f) in May.
runners.comment: Best form at 1m2f on AW; needs more than shown for current yard

runners.name: Si White
runners.spotlight: Three runs at about 1m on AW, faring slightly better at Wolverhampton in January when holding a prominent position until over 1f out and not persevered with; goes handicapping off a lowly mark in an ordinary race over a trip that should suit; very likely to outstrip early efforts; market will guide.
runners.comment: Hint of ability at about 1m; likely to outstrip early efforts now up in trip in a handicap
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xxx & Chris Rees

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Sparkling Wine
runners.spotlight: 0-6 on turf but did not have an ideal track position when going close at Beverley (5f, good to firm) nine days ago; effectively 1lb higher today but due to be another 1lb higher soon; will be dangerous if suited by this new surface.
runners.comment: 0-6 on turf but did well to go close at Beverley recently; major player on AW debut

runners.name: My Mate Mackley
runners.spotlight: Dead-heated on handicap debut at Chepstow (5f, good to soft) in May and bounced back from a lesser effort when keeping-on second at Ffos Las (5f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last month; not yet proven on AW surfaces but still respected.
runners.comment: Dead-heated on turf in May and again ran well last month; respected

runners.name: Havin A Flyer
runners.spotlight: Remains a maiden after 20 starts but was placed in C&D classified last month (wore cheekpieces) and again ran quite well in that grade at Wolverhampton 16 days ago; back in a handicap off career-low mark; has a big role to play.
runners.comment: Placed in 5f AW classified races on last two starts; has another big role to play

runners.name: Agric Ranger
runners.spotlight: Weakened into fifth of six after racing too freely on handicap debut at Catterick (6f, good to firm) in May but remains unexposed and may benefit from this drop in trip.
runners.comment: Weakened into fifth of six on handicap debut (6f); may benefit from drop to 5f

runners.name: Jooliah
runners.spotlight: Yet to show any significant promise after six runs (6f-7f); dropped in trip and tried in a visor today.
runners.comment: Yet to show any significant promise after six runs; dropped in trip and tried in a visor

runners.name: Henriette Ronner
runners.spotlight: Displayed improvement to win in first-time blinkers for William Haggas at Newcastle (6f) in January but subsequent 6f/7f form for two different stables has been disappointing (latest run was her first in a visor); drops to 5f with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Recent 6f/7f form has been disappointing; drops to 5f with quite a bit to prove

runners.name: Golden Harvest
runners.spotlight: Well beaten over 7f on first two starts and may have been flattered by proximity when fifth in slowly run race at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) last time; drops in trip again for handicap/AW debut; improvement needed.
runners.comment: Struggled on first two starts (7f) and may have been flattered by proximity last time (6f)

races.race_name: Free Digital Racecard At Raceday-Ready.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Anchiano
runners.spotlight: Well beaten when sent off favourite on his debut in May but took a big step forward over this C&D last week (good to firm), making all in a first-time hood (retained); carries a penalty but he's the one to beat.
runners.comment: Took big step forward from his debut in a first-time hood last week, making all over C&D
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: Evenfall
runners.spotlight: Filly by Harry Angel; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Simmering (6f/7f 2yo including Group 2; RPR 108) and Estate (5f; 84); dam 7f 2yo winner (82), closely related to 5f-7.4f winner Muatadel, out of 6f Group 3 winner; interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: Filly by Harry Angel; half-sister to Group 2 winner Simmering; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Minster Man
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros foal, £78,000 breeze-up buy; Blackbeard colt; second foal; dam 5f/6f winner (including AW; RPR 81), half-sister to winners A Momentofmadness (useful 5f/6f including 2yo) and Arc Royal (7f 2yo), out of 6f 2yo winner, is granddaughter of 6f 2yo Group 3 winner; has a speedy pedigree and he's one to be interested in on his debut.
runners.comment: £78,000 breeze-up buy; second foal out of a 5f/6f winner (81); has a speedy pedigree

runners.name: Sultan Darius
runners.spotlight: Tongue-tied for two previous starts but not today; pulled too hard when fourth of 13 on his debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) and again took a firm grip before fading into eighth at Doncaster (6f, good to firm); this drop in trip could help him settle better.
runners.comment: Raced freely in two starts over 6f but could settle better over this shorter trip

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap

runners.name: Man Of Desert
runners.spotlight: Best efforts have been over C&D and he ran well when second of five here in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) three weeks ago; he's on a handy mark and can go well.
runners.comment: Best efforts have been over C&D and he ran well here in a first-time tongue-tie latest

runners.name: Panelli
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 14 starts came in a Lingfield maiden (1m, AW) in September on his final start for George Boughey; runner-up twice on the AW at the beginning of the year, and he may have needed his first start since February at Epsom (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago.
runners.comment: 1-14; may have needed his first start since February when fourth of six at Epsom latest

runners.name: Rogue Dynasty
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 14 starts came at Chester (7f, good; first-time hood) on her stable debut last July and she's posted some good efforts since, including at Brighton (1m) on her last two starts (carried head awkwardly latest); solid contender.
runners.comment: Has posted some good efforts since winning at Chester on her stable debut; solid claims

runners.name: Drifts Away
runners.spotlight: Five of his six wins have been on the AW and the other came here over 7f last May (good to soft); well beaten on his last three starts, including at Newmarket last time on his first start for ten months, and is now tried in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Sole win on turf came here on good to soft; well beaten on return and cheekpieces go on

runners.name: Mr Nugget
runners.spotlight: All six wins have been on the AW, the most recent coming at Southwell (1m, AW) in February; he was in fair form when last seen four months ago but has failed to beat a rival home in each of his three starts on turf.
runners.comment: All six wins have been on the AW and has failed to beat a rival in three starts on turf

runners.name: Distinct Spirit
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since making a winning debut at Salisbury (7f, good) in 2024 but ran creditably when ridden by Ebrahim Nader at Newbury (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; that was his first outing for nine months and he may well come on for it; claims.
runners.comment: Lightly raced; creditable effort at Newbury on his first start for nine months; claims

runners.name: War Chant
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner when trained by Rae Guest and posted respectable efforts on the AW over 1m2f in two of his three outings for Edward Smyth-Osbourne; has been off since January and drops back in trip on his first start for this yard.
runners.comment: Seven-time winner when trained by Rae Guest; off since January and makes his stable debut

races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap

runners.name: Hardy's Hero
runners.spotlight: Won 6f maiden and novice events as a 2yo; has posted three good efforts since being gelded, the most recent when narrowly denied in a three-runner handicap at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago; contender.
runners.comment: 2-7; has posted three good efforts since being gelded, including at Newmarket last time

runners.name: Caviar Cowboy
runners.spotlight: All six starts have been on the AW; won at Lingfield (7f) in April before a good second of 13 at Kempton next time, and ran respectably in a 0-105 at Newcastle (7f) last month; drops in grade and has strong claims if coping with the surface on his turf debut.
runners.comment: All six starts on the AW; respectable effort in a 0-105 latest and now makes turf debut

runners.name: Three Non Blondes
runners.spotlight: Two wins from four starts for Karl Burke (6f/7f; AW); ran well when third at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) on last month's stable and turf debut, but she was well held at Newmarket two weeks ago (hung left); needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner (6f/7f); ran well on her stable debut but well held at Newmarket latest

runners.name: Starfinch
runners.spotlight: Made a winning stable debut in a Southwell novice (6f, AW) in January and took another step forward when sixth of eight in a Listed event at Lingfield (7f, AW) next time; now makes her handicap debut having been off since failing to beat a rival in a Goodwood Listed event in May and still needs to prove herself on turf.
runners.comment: Won a 6f AW novice in January; failed to beat a rival in two starts on turf though
runners.owner: Mrs Frank Barry & Mrs Luke Barry

races.race_name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap

runners.name: Rogue Allegiance
runners.spotlight: Without a win since his debut in 2024 (posted an RPR of 89) but he was placed in each of his three starts for Jack Jones, and went close over C&D on his stable debut four weeks ago; he's on a handy mark and has to be respected.
runners.comment: Placed in each of his three starts for Jack Jones and went close over C&D on yard debut

runners.name: Mercury Day
runners.spotlight: Won twice at around 1m in June 2024; never dangerous when eighth of 12 in a 0-100 at York (6f, good) last month and she possibly wasn't helped by racing in a small group of three at Newbury (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; claims in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Possibly wasn't helped by racing in a small group at Newbury latest; blinkers go on

runners.name: Berry Clever
runners.spotlight: Three of his four wins have been on the AW and the other came over this C&D in May off a 3lb lower mark than today's; ran respectably over 1m here four weeks ago and holds solid claims back down in trip.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in May and ran respectably here over 1m four weeks ago; holds solid claims

runners.name: Campani
runners.spotlight: Came home nicely to win at Chelmsford (7f, AW; first start for 95 days) in January and was returning from a 50-day break when winning over 1m here (good to firm) three weeks ago; goes up in grade off a 3lb higher mark and will need them to go a solid gallop over this shorter trip.
runners.comment: Won at Chelmsford in January and here over 1m three weeks ago; up in grade off 3lb higher

runners.name: Mr Ubiquitous
runners.spotlight: Gained his sixth success when winning at Kempton (7f, AW) in March on his reappearance but he's been below that level in both starts since, including at Newbury three weeks ago; drops in grade but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Won on the AW at Kempton in March but below that level in two starts on turf since

runners.name: North View
runners.spotlight: Won on the AW over 7f at Chelmsford in January on his stable debut but he's been below his best on turf in recent starts, including when last of six over 1m here last month; visor now applied.
runners.comment: 7f AW winner in January on his stable but below his best on turf recently; visor goes on

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners.name: Caraway
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when winning at Thirsk (1m4f, good) in May off 5lb lower, then seemed stretched by 1m6f on soft at Nottingham; ran well when close second of three at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) last night and she will have to be respected if running today.
runners.comment: Close second of three at Leicester last night; has to be respected if running today

runners.name: Maith Mar Or
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who ran to a similar level in three starts last year, but she was tailed off in a three-runner event at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) on her handicap debut four weeks ago; steps up in trip and she may yet do better.
runners.comment: Ran to a similar level in three starts last year but tailed off on her handicap debut

runners.name: Twilight Guest
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick when winning at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last June but he mostly hasn't been at his best since; respectable effort at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) last time but he still needs to prove his stamina for this far.
runners.comment: Completed a hat-trick last year but mostly been below his best since; unproven over 1m4f

runners.name: Gretna Dreams
runners.spotlight: Won twice last August, at Brighton (1m2f, good) and Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm); below her best on her next three outings and she was brought down at Brighton last month; unproven over this trip.
runners.comment: Won twice last August over 1m2f; brought down last time and unproven over this trip
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Mr Bollinger
runners.spotlight: Well held in three novice/maiden events in April/May and he was beaten 20l on his handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last month; steps up to 1m4f with headgear discarded.
runners.comment: Well held in three novice/maiden events and beaten 20l on his handicap debut over 1m2f

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap

runners.name: Charging Bull
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; went close in a handicap at Nottingham (5f, soft) last month but he raced freely in a classified event over this trip at Lingfield (good) a week later; has the hood back on and needs to settle better.
runners.comment: 0-12; went close over 5f last month but raced freely over this trip latest; hood back on

runners.name: Havana Jag
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden but she ran her best race when second of eight at Newbury (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago on her second start for this stable; steps back up in trip with claims.
runners.comment: 0-11 but ran her best race when runner-up at Newbury three weeks ago; back up in trip

runners.name: Due Date
runners.spotlight: Five wins in 2025 include one over C&D; has shaped as if back in form on his last two starts, including when a front-running second of five at Leicester (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago; should go well.
runners.comment: C&D win last year; ran well when front-running second at Leicester last time; can go well
runners.owner: A Bangs & Miss J A Challen

runners.name: Chasing Gold
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning in first-time blinkers over C&D last month (soft) and shaped as if still in good form when fourth of 12 at Windsor (5f, good to firm) one month ago, leaving the impression he'll be well suited to stepping back up in trip; contender.
runners.comment: C&D winner last month; good run at Windsor over 5f since; step back up in trip will suit

runners.name: Blindfold Games
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden but she has been placed on three occasions, including when second of four at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) last month; has cheekpieces back on and makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: 0-11 but has been placed on three occasions; cheekpieces back on; shortlisted

runners.name: Rianka
runners.spotlight: Best effort in three novice/maiden events when fifth of ten at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; didn't look suited by the drop to 5f on her handicap debut back there last time (tongue-tied for the first time) and now steps back up in trip.
runners.comment: Didn't look suited by the drop to 5f on her handicap debut at Windsor; back up in trip

runners.name: Ballsgrove Boy
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f AW winner for Martin Dunne, latterly at Wolverhampton last July; mostly struggled since and now makes his stable debut/reappearance having been secured for 14,000gns.
runners.comment: Dual 6f AW winner for previous yard; makes his stable debut having been off since October

runners.name: One For Harvey
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 14 starts came at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last May off a 5lb higher mark than today's; below her best when last seen 287 days ago and makes her stable debut having left Julia & Shelley Birkett (bought for 5,000gns).
runners.comment: One win from 14 starts; has left Julia & Shelley Birkett since last seen 287 days ago

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Handicap

runners.name: Roi De Coeur
runners.spotlight: Posted an improved effort when winning on his handicap debut at Kempton (1m, AW) two weeks ago, pulling 3l clear with the runner-up; now 5lb higher but he's open to further progress; contender.
runners.comment: Made a winning handicap debut at Kempton two weeks ago; up 5lb; open to further progress

runners.name: Chapman's Peak
runners.spotlight: Won twice on the AW at Kempton in October (1m/7f) but he's struggled in three starts this year; all starts on turf have been on ground slower than good, and he has a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Won twice at Kempton in October but has struggled in three starts since; bit to prove

runners.name: Guest House
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning over this C&D in April off 4lb lower; raced too freely over 1m2f at Newmarket in May and he was well held on the July Course last month; return to this track may help.
runners.comment: Off the mark when winning over C&D in April; well held at Newmarket last time

runners.name: Celtic Chariot
runners.spotlight: Solid fourth on his handicap debut at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last month and built on that when winning at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; steps up in grade off this 3lb higher mark but he could have more to offer after just five starts.
runners.comment: Built on his handicap debut when winning at Doncaster two weeks ago; now 3lb higher
